title.raw: 卷七 本紀第七: 中宗 睿宗 Volume 7 Annals 7: Zhongzong, Ruizong

sentences.zh: __FORCETOC__中宗中宗大和聖昭孝皇帝諱顯，高宗第七子，母曰則天順聖皇后。

translations.literal: Zhongzong (section). Emperor Zhongzong, posthumous title Great Harmonious Sagely Illustrious Filial, bore the taboo name Xian, seventh son of Gaozong; his mother was Empress Zetian the Shunsheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzong — Emperor Zhongzong, styled Great Harmonious Sagely Illustrious Filial, bore the taboo name Xian. He was Gaozong's seventh son; his mother was Empress Zetian the Shunsheng.

sentences.zh: 顯慶元年十一月乙丑，生於長安。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Xianqing, on yichou, he was born in Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Xianqing 1, on yichou, he was born in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 明年封周王，授洛州牧。

translations.literal: The next year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhou and appointed Military Governor of Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was created Prince of Zhou and made military governor of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳二年，徙封英王，改名哲，授雍州牧。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yifeng he was transferred to Prince of Ying, his name changed to Zhe, and he was appointed Military Governor of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Yifeng 2 he was made Prince of Ying, renamed Zhe, and appointed military governor of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 永隆元年，章懷太子廢，其年立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yonglong, Crown Prince Zhanghuai was deposed; that same year he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In Yonglong 1 Crown Prince Zhanghuai was deposed, and that year he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 弘道元年十二月，高宗崩，遺詔皇太子柩前即帝位。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Hongdao, Gaozong died; by the late emperor's testament the crown prince took the throne before the bier.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Hongdao 1 Gaozong died, and by his testament the crown prince ascended before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 皇太后臨朝稱制，改元嗣聖。

translations.literal: The empress dowager held court and exercised regency, and the era name was changed to Zisheng.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager ruled from behind the curtain and renamed the era Zisheng.

sentences.zh: 元年二月，皇太后廢帝為廬陵王，幽於別所。

translations.literal: In the second month of the inaugural year she deposed the emperor as Prince of Luling and confined him in a separate residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of that year she demoted him to Prince of Luling and shut him away.

sentences.zh: 其年五月，遷於均州，尋徙居房陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year he was moved to Junzhou, and soon after transferred to Fangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was exiled to Junzhou, then soon moved to Fangling.

sentences.zh: 聖歷元年，召還東都，立為皇太子，依舊名顯。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shenglü he was recalled to the eastern capital, installed as crown prince, and restored to his former name Xian.
translations.idiomatic: In Shenglü 1 he was recalled to Luoyang, made crown prince again, and took back the name Xian.

sentences.zh: 時張易之與弟昌宗潛圖逆亂。

translations.literal: At that time Zhang Yizhi and his brother Changzong secretly plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: By then Zhang Yizhi and his brother Changzong were plotting treason in secret.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年神龍元年正月，鳳閣侍郎張柬之、鸞臺侍郎崔玄暐、左羽林將軍敬暉、右羽林將軍桓彥範、司刑少卿袁恕己等定策率羽林兵誅易之、昌宗，迎皇太子監國，總司庶政。

translations.literal: In the first month of Shenlong 1, Fengge Vice Minister Zhang Jianzhi, Luantai Vice Minister Cui Xuanwei, Left Feathered Forest General Jing Hui, Right Feathered Forest General Huan Yanfan, and Vice Director of Punishments Yuan Shuji and others settled the plan, led the feathered forest troops to execute Yizhi and Changzong, welcomed the crown prince to oversee the state, and took charge of all government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Shenlong 1, Zhang Jianzhi of Fengge, Cui Xuanwei of Luantai, Jing Hui and Huan Yanfan of the feathered forest guards, and Yuan Shuji of the punishments bureau led the guard in killing Yizhi and Changzong, brought the crown prince to govern as regent, and seized the reins of state.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The court proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 鳳閣侍郎韋承慶、正諫大夫房融、司禮卿崔神慶等下獄。

translations.literal: Fengge Vice Minister Wei Chengqing, Remonstrator Fang Rong, and Minister of Rites Cui Shenqing and others were imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Chengqing of Fengge, Remonstrator Fang Rong, and Cui Shenqing, minister of rites, were thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命地官侍郎樊忱往京師告廟陵。

translations.literal: On jiachen he ordered Vice Minister of Earthly Offices Fan Chen to go to the capital to announce the news at the ancestral temples and tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he sent Fan Chen, vice minister of earthly offices, to Chang'an to report at the temples and imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 司刑少卿兼相王府司馬袁恕己為鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Yuan Shuji, vice director of punishments and concurrent marshal of the Prince of Xiang's household, became equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shuji, vice director of punishments and marshal to the Prince of Xiang, joined the third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，則天傳位於皇太子。

translations.literal: On yisi Zetian transferred the throne to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Empress Zetian abdicated in favor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丙午，即皇帝位於通天宮，大赦天下，唯易之黨與不在原限。

translations.literal: On bingwu he took the throne at the Hall of Penetrating Heaven, proclaimed a general amnesty, excepting the faction of Yizhi from the original scope of pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he ascended at the Hall of Penetrating Heaven, proclaimed amnesty, and excluded Yizhi's faction from the pardon.

sentences.zh: 為周興、來俊臣所枉陷者，咸令雪免。

translations.literal: All who had been falsely implicated by Zhou Xing and Lai Junchen were ordered cleared and restored.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone framed by Zhou Xing and Lai Junchen was cleared and restored.

sentences.zh: 內外文武官加兩階，三品已上加爵二等，入五品等特減四考。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without were advanced two ranks; those of the third rank and above received two degrees of nobility; those entering the fifth rank and above had four merit examinations specially reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Every official, civil or military, gained two ranks; third rank and above received two noble degrees; those newly reaching fifth rank had four examinations waived.

sentences.zh: 大酺五日。

translations.literal: Public feasting for five days.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted five days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 以並州牧相王旦及太平公主有誅易之兄弟功，相王加號安國相王，進拜太尉、同鳳閣鸞臺三品；

translations.literal: Because Prince Dan of Xiang, military governor of Bingzhou, and Princess Taiping had merit in executing the Zhang brothers, the prince was given the added title Pacifying-the-State Prince of Xiang and promoted to Grand Marshal, equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dan of Xiang, governor of Bingzhou, and Princess Taiping had helped kill the Zhang brothers; the prince took the added title Pacifying-the-State Prince of Xiang and rose to grand marshal of third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace;

sentences.zh: 公主加號鎮國太平公主，仍賜實封，通前滿五千戶。

translations.literal: the princess was given the added title Pacifying-the-Realm Princess Taiping, with a substantive fief; counting earlier grants, her fief reached five thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: the princess became Pacifying-the-Realm Princess Taiping with a new substantive fief, bringing her total to five thousand households.

sentences.zh: 皇親先被配沒者，子孫令復屬籍，仍量敘官爵。

translations.literal: Imperial kinsmen earlier confiscated and banished were ordered to have their descendants restored to the clan registers and given offices and titles as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of confiscated imperial kin were restored to the registers and given offices and titles as their merits allowed.

sentences.zh: 出宮女三千。

translations.literal: Three thousand palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand palace women were sent out of the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，天后徙居上陽宮。

translations.literal: On dingwei the Heavenly Empress moved to the Shangyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the retired empress moved to Shangyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，鳳閣侍郎同鳳閣鸞臺平章事張柬之為夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺三品，封漢陽郡公；

translations.literal: On gengxu Zhang Jianzhi, Fengge vice minister and equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace, became Minister of Summer Offices, equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Hanyang;
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhang Jianzhi became minister of summer offices of third rank at Phoenix Pavilion and Terrace and was created Duke of Hanyang;

sentences.zh: 鸞臺侍郎兼檢校太子右庶子、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事崔玄暐為守內史，封博陵郡公；

translations.literal: Cui Xuanwei, Luantai vice minister and concurrent right aide to the crown prince, equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace, became acting Secretariat Director and was enfeoffed as Duke of Boling;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xuanwei, Luantai vice minister and crown prince aide, became acting secretariat director and Duke of Boling;

sentences.zh: 袁恕己同鳳閣鸞臺三品，封南陽郡公；

translations.literal: Yuan Shuji, equal in rank to the Three Offices at Phoenix Pavilion and Phoenix Terrace, was enfeoffed as Duke of Nanyang;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shuji of third rank was created Duke of Nanyang;

sentences.zh: 敬暉為納言、平陽郡公；

translations.literal: Jing Hui became Attendant-in-Chief and Duke of Pingyang;
translations.idiomatic: Jing Hui became attendant-in-chief and Duke of Pingyang;

sentences.zh: 桓彥範為納言、譙郡公：並加銀青光祿大夫，賜實封五百戶。

translations.literal: Huan Yanfan became Attendant-in-Chief and Duke of Qiao: all were given the silver-blue-glow grandee rank and a substantive fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Yanfan became attendant-in-chief and Duke of Qiao; all received the silver-blue-glow grandee rank and fiefs of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 右羽林大將軍、遼國公李多祚進封遼陽郡王，賜實封六百戶；

translations.literal: Li Duozuo, right general of the feathered forest guards and Duke of Liaoguo, was advanced to Prince of Liaoyang commandery with a substantive fief of six hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: Li Duozuo, right general of the feathered forest, was raised to Prince of Liaoyang with a fief of six hundred households;

sentences.zh: 內直郎、駙馬都尉王同皎為雲麾將軍、右千牛將軍、瑯邪郡公，食實封五百戶。

translations.literal: Wang Tongjiao, inner attendant and commandant-consort, became general of the cloud-banners guard, right thousand-ox general, and Duke of Langye, with a substantive fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tongjiao, inner attendant and imperial son-in-law, became cloud-banners general, right thousand-ox general, and Duke of Langye with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 並賞誅張易之兄弟功。

translations.literal: All were rewarded for merit in executing the Zhang brothers.
translations.idiomatic: All were rewarded for killing the Zhang brothers.

sentences.zh: 其餘封各有差。

translations.literal: Other enfeoffments were graded accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Other rewards were graded by merit.

sentences.zh: 上天后尊號為則天大聖皇帝。

translations.literal: The retired empress was given the honorific title Great Sage Emperor Zetian.
translations.idiomatic: The retired empress was styled Great Sage Emperor Zetian.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，復國號，依舊為唐。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the second month the dynastic name was restored; it remained Tang as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the second month the dynasty was restored to Tang.

sentences.zh: 社稷、宗廟、陵寢、郊祀、行軍旗幟、服色、天地、日月、寺宇、臺閣、官名，並依永淳已前故事。

translations.literal: The altars of soil and grain, ancestral temples, tombs, suburban sacrifices, campaign banners and flags, colors of dress, heaven and earth, sun and moon, monasteries, terrace offices, and official titles—all followed the precedents before Yongchun.
translations.idiomatic: Altars, temples, tombs, suburban rites, banners, dress, celestial names, monasteries, offices, and titles all reverted to pre-Yongchun usage.

sentences.zh: 神都依舊為東都，北都為並州大都督府，老君依舊為玄元皇帝。

translations.literal: The Divine Capital again became the Eastern Capital; the Northern Capital again became the metropolitan prefecture of Bingzhou; Lord Lao again became the Mysterious Primordial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang again became the eastern capital, Taiyuan the northern metropolitan prefecture, and Lord Lao again the Mysterious Primordial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 諸州百姓免今年租稅，房州百姓給復三年。

translations.literal: The people of all prefectures were exempted from this year's land tax and levies; the people of Fang Prefecture received tax relief for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Every prefecture was excused this year's taxes; Fang Prefecture received three years' relief.

sentences.zh: 改左右肅政臺為左右御史臺。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Offices for Censorial Reform were changed back to the Left and Right Censorates.
translations.idiomatic: The censorial reform offices were restored as the left and right censorates.

sentences.zh: 韋承慶貶高要尉，房融配流欽州。

translations.literal: Wei Chengqing was demoted to captain of Gaoyao; Fang Rong was banished to Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Chengqing was demoted to Gaoyao captain; Fang Rong was exiled to Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 中書令楊再思為戶部尚書、同中書門下三品、京留守；

translations.literal: Yang Zaisi, Secretariat Director, became Minister of Revenue, equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery, and Capital Intendant;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaisi became minister of revenue of third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery and capital intendant;

sentences.zh: 太僕卿、同中書門下三品姚元之出為亳州刺史。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanzhi, Grand Master of Splendid Carriages and equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery, was sent out as prefect of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanzhi, grand master of splendid carriages of third rank, was sent out as prefect of Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，封堂兄左金吾將軍、鬱林郡公千里為成紀郡王、左金吾衛大將軍，實封五百戶。

translations.literal: On jiwei his elder cousin Qianli, left general of the golden guards and Duke of Yulin commandery, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chengji commandery and left general of the golden guards, with a substantive fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei his cousin Qianli, left golden-guard general and Duke of Yulin, was made Prince of Chengji and left golden-guard general with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 令貢舉人停習《臣軌》，依舊習《老子》。

translations.literal: Candidates for the examinations were ordered to cease studying the Guidelines for Ministers and again study the Laozi.
translations.idiomatic: Exam candidates were told to drop the Guidelines for Ministers and resume study of the Laozi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立妃韋氏為皇后，大赦天下，內外官陪位者賜勛一轉，大酺三日。

translations.literal: On jiazi the consort Wei was installed as empress; a general amnesty was proclaimed; officials attending received one turn on the merit roll; public feasting for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Consort Wei became empress; the court proclaimed amnesty, granted attending officials one merit turn, and feasted for three days.

sentences.zh: 后父故豫州刺史玄貞為上洛郡王，后母崔氏贈上洛郡王妃。

translations.literal: The empress's late father, the former prefect of Yu, Xuanzhen, was made Prince of Shangluo commandery; the empress's mother, the Cui clan, was posthumously created Princess of Shangluo commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's father Xuanzhen, late prefect of Yu, was made Prince of Shangluo; her mother Lady Cui was posthumously made princess of Shangluo.

sentences.zh: 初，韓王元嘉、霍王元軌等自垂拱以來皆遭非命，是日追復官爵，令備禮改葬，有胤嗣者即令承襲，無胤嗣者聽取親為後。

translations.literal: At first, Princes Yuanjia of Han, Yuangui of Huo, and others had all met wrongful death since the Chuigong era; that day their offices and titles were posthumously restored, proper rites ordered for reburial, and where there were heirs succession was permitted; where there were none, a close kinsman might be adopted as heir.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Yuanjia of Han, Yuangui of Huo, and others wrongfully killed since Chuigong had their honors restored that day, were reburied with full rites, and heirs or adoptive kin were allowed to succeed.

sentences.zh: 詔九品已上及朝集使極言朝政得失，兼舉賢良方正直言極諫之士。

translations.literal: An edict ordered officials of the ninth rank and above and provincial assembly envoys to speak frankly on the gains and losses of government, and also to recommend men of worth, integrity, and forthright remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded officials of the ninth rank and above and assembly envoys to speak frankly on policy and recommend worthy, upright remonstrators.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，左散騎常侍、譙王重福貶濮州員外刺史，不知州事。

translations.literal: On bingyin Prince Chongfu of Qiao was demoted to supernumerary prefect of Puzhou, without charge of prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Prince Chongfu of Qiao was demoted to supernumerary prefect of Pu, without governing authority.

sentences.zh: 特進、太子賓客、梁王武三思為司空、同中書門下三品，加實封五百戶，通前一千五百戶。

translations.literal: Wu Sansi, special advance and crown prince mentor and Prince of Liang, became Minister of Works, equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery, with an added substantive fief of five hundred households, reaching one thousand five hundred in all.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sansi, special advance, crown prince mentor, and Prince of Liang, became minister of works of third rank with a new fief of five hundred households, for fifteen hundred in all.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，右散騎常侍、定安郡王、駙馬都尉武攸暨封定王，為司徒，更加實封四百戶，通前一千戶。

translations.literal: On dingmao Wu Youji, right attendant-in-ordinary and Prince of Ding'an commandery and commandant-consort, was enfeoffed as Prince of Ding, made Minister of Education, and given another four hundred households in substantive fief, reaching one thousand in all.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wu Youji, right attendant and imperial son-in-law, was made Prince of Ding and minister of education with four hundred added households, for one thousand in all.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上往觀風殿朝天后。

translations.literal: On xinwei the emperor went to the Hall of Observing the Wind to attend upon the retired empress.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the emperor visited the retired empress at the Hall of Observing the Wind.

sentences.zh: 太尉、安國相王旦固讓太尉及知政事，遂從其請。

translations.literal: Prince Dan of Xiang, grand marshal, firmly declined the grand marshal post and participation in government; his request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dan of Xiang, grand marshal, refused the grand marshal post and a seat in government, and the emperor let him step down.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，國子祭酒祝欽明同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Zhu Qinming, libationer of the Directorate of Education, became equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhu Qinming, directorate libationer, joined the third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎、知侍中事韋安石為刑部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Wei Anshi, vice minister of the yellow gate and in charge of secretariat affairs, became Minister of Punishments and ceased participation in government.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Anshi, yellow-gate vice minister acting for the secretariat, became minister of punishments and left the council.

sentences.zh: 丙子，諸州置寺、觀一所，以「中興」為名。

translations.literal: On bingzi each prefecture was to establish one monastery and one Daoist abbey, to be named "Restoration."
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi every prefecture was ordered to found one monastery and one abbey named Restoration.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，武三思固讓司空、同中書門下三品，武攸暨固讓司徒、封王，許之。

translations.literal: On dingchou Wu Sansi firmly declined Minister of Works and equal rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery; Wu Youji firmly declined Minister of Education and princely enfeoffment; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Wu Sansi and Wu Youji were allowed to decline their new honors.

sentences.zh: 改封義興郡王重俊為衛王，北海郡王重茂為溫王。

translations.literal: Prince Chongjun of Yixing commandery was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Wei; Prince Chongmao of Beihai commandery as Prince of Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chongjun of Yixing was made Prince of Wei; Prince Chongmao of Beihai was made Prince of Wen.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，追復故司空、英國公李勣官爵，令所司為起墳改葬。

translations.literal: On xinsi the late Minister of Works and Duke of Ying Li Ji had his office and title posthumously restored, and the relevant offices were ordered to raise his tomb and rebury him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Ji, late minister of works and Duke of Ying, had his honors restored and was ordered reburied with full rites.

sentences.zh: 甲申，制文明已來破家臣僚所有子孫，並還資廕。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict restored to their families the confiscated property of officials ruined since the Wenming era.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen property seized from officials ruined since Wenming was ordered returned to their families.

sentences.zh: 其揚州構逆徒黨，唯徐敬業一房不在免限，餘並原宥。

translations.literal: Among the Yangzhou rebels only Xu Jingye's line was excluded from pardon; the rest were forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Yangzhou rebels only Xu Jingye's house was barred from amnesty; all others were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，廢左右司員外郎。

translations.literal: On dinghai the supernumerary vice directors of the left and right secretariats were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the supernumerary secretariat vice directors were abolished.

sentences.zh: 其酷吏劉光業、王德壽、王處貞、屈貞筠、劉景陽等五人，雖已身死，官爵並宜追奪；

translations.literal: Of the cruel officials Liu Guangye, Wang Deshou, Wang Chuzhen, Qu Zhenjun, and Liu Jingyang—though already dead—their offices and titles were to be posthumously stripped;
translations.idiomatic: The cruel officials Liu Guangye, Wang Deshou, Wang Chuzhen, Qu Zhenjun, and Liu Jingyang, though dead, had their titles stripped;

sentences.zh: 景陽見在，貶祿州樂單尉。

translations.literal: Jingyang, still living, was demoted to captain of Ledan in Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jingyang, still alive, was demoted to Ledan captain in Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 丘神勣、來子珣，萬國俊、周興、來俊臣、魚承曄、王景昭、索元禮、傅游藝、王弘義、張知默、裴籍、焦仁亶、侯思立、郭霸、李敬仁、皇甫文備、陳嘉言等雖已身死，並宜除名。

translations.literal: Qiu Shenji, Lai Zixun, Wan Guojun, Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, Yu Chengye, Wang Jingzhao, Suo Yuanli, Fu Youyi, Wang Hongyi, Zhang Zhim, Pei Ji, Jiao Renchan, Hou Sil, Guo Ba, Li Jingren, Huangfu Wenbei, Chen Jiayan, and others—though already dead—were all to be struck from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Shenji, Lai Zixun, Wan Guojun, Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, and a host of other dead persecutors were erased from the registers.

sentences.zh: 唐奉一配流，李秦授、曹仁哲並改與嶺南遠惡處。

translations.literal: Tang Fengyi was banished; Li Qinshou and Cao Renzhe were both reassigned to the far south.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Fengyi was exiled; Li Qinshou and Cao Renzhe were sent to the distant south.

sentences.zh: 己丑，中書侍郎兼檢校相王府長史、南陽郡公袁恕己為中書令，兼檢校安國相王府長史。

translations.literal: On jichou Yuan Shuji, vice minister of the secretariat and concurrent chief administrator of the Pacifying-the-State Prince of Xiang's household and Duke of Nanyang, became Secretariat Director and concurrent chief administrator of the Pacifying-the-State Prince of Xiang's household.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Yuan Shuji, secretariat vice minister and administrator to Prince Dan of Xiang, became secretariat director while keeping his post with the prince.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「君臣朝序，貴賤之禮斯殊；

translations.literal: An edict said: "In court the sequence of lord and minister distinguishes noble and base;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "In court the order of lord and minister sets rank high and low;

sentences.zh: 兄弟大倫，先後之儀亦異。

translations.literal: among brothers the great bond likewise distinguishes precedence.
translations.idiomatic: among brothers kinship likewise sets who comes first.

sentences.zh: 聖人之制，率由斯道。

translations.literal: The sages' institutions all proceed from this principle.
translations.idiomatic: The sages founded their rites on this principle.

sentences.zh: 朕臨茲寶極，位在崇高。

translations.literal: We hold this precious pinnacle, standing in the highest place.
translations.idiomatic: We occupy the sacred throne, raised to the highest place.

sentences.zh: 負扆當陽，雖受宗枝之敬；

translations.literal: Facing south behind the screen, we receive the clan's reverence in audience;
translations.idiomatic: Facing south behind the screen we receive the clan's reverence in audience;

sentences.zh: 退朝私謁，仍用家人之禮。

translations.literal: in private withdrawal we still use the family rites.
translations.idiomatic: in private we still keep the family rites.

sentences.zh: 近代以來，罕遵軌度，王及公主，曲致私情，姑叔之尊，拜於子侄，違法背禮，情用惻然。

translations.literal: In recent times few have kept to the measure: kings and princesses have bent ritual to private feeling; aunts and uncles of honored rank have bowed to nephews and nieces—against law and against propriety, and the heart is pained.
translations.idiomatic: Lately few have kept the measure: princes and princesses have bent rite to private feeling; uncles and aunts of honored rank have bowed to nephews and nieces—against law and propriety, and it pains us.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，宜從革弊。

translations.literal: From this time forward such abuses are to be reformed.
translations.idiomatic: From this day such abuses are to end.

sentences.zh: 安國相王某及鎮國太平公主更不得輒拜衛王重俊兄弟及長寧公主姊妹等。

translations.literal: The Pacifying-the-State Prince of Xiang and the Pacifying-the-Realm Princess Taiping must no longer bow to Prince Chongjun of Wei and his brothers or to Princess Changning and her sisters.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dan of Xiang and Princess Taiping must no longer bow to Prince Chongjun of Wei and his brothers or to Princess Changning and her sisters.

sentences.zh: 宜告宗屬，知朕意焉。

translations.literal: Let the clan be told, so all may know Our intent."
translations.idiomatic: Let the clan be told, so all may know our intent."

sentences.zh: 」先是，諸王及公主皆以親為貴，天子之子，諸姑叔見之必先致拜，若致書則稱為啟事。

translations.literal: Earlier, princes and princesses all treated kinship as rank: the emperor's sons, and all aunts and uncles on meeting them, first bowed; in letters they styled their messages "memorials."
translations.idiomatic: Before this, princes and princesses had treated blood as rank: the emperor's sons, and every aunt and uncle, bowed first on meeting them, and in letters called their notes memorials.

sentences.zh: 上志欲敦睦親族，故下制革之。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to deepen harmony among kin; therefore he issued this edict to reform it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished warmer kinship; hence this reforming edict.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，衛王重俊上洛州牧。

translations.literal: On gengyin Prince Chongjun of Wei became Military Governor of Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Prince Chongjun of Wei became military governor of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 王乘駟馬車，鹵簿從；

translations.literal: The prince rode a four-horse carriage with full guard;
translations.idiomatic: He rode a four-horse carriage with full guard;

sentences.zh: 諸王公已下、中書門下五品已上及諸親並祖送，禮儀甚盛。

translations.literal: all princes and dukes below him, fifth-rank officials of the secretariat and chancellery and above, and all kin escorted him—the ceremony was very grand.
translations.idiomatic: every prince and duke below him, every secretariat and chancellery official of the fifth rank and above, and all kin escorted him in a splendid procession.

sentences.zh: 事畢，賜物有差。

translations.literal: When the affair was finished, gifts were bestowed in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: When it was done, gifts were given in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以故司僕少卿徐有功執法平恕，追贈越州都督，並授一子官。

translations.literal: On xinmao, because the late Director of Palace Steeds Xu Yougong had judged cases with fairness and mercy, he was posthumously made military governor of Yue and one son was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Xu Yougong, late director of palace steeds, was posthumously made governor of Yue and one son given office for his fair judgments.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，左右千牛衛各置大將軍一員。

translations.literal: On wuxu one post of great general was established in each of the left and right thousand-ox guards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu each thousand-ox guard was given one great general.

sentences.zh: 罷奉宸府官員。

translations.literal: The staff of the Attendant Court Bureau were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Attendant Court Bureau staff were abolished.

sentences.zh: 以安北大都護、安國相王旦為左右千牛大將軍，每大朝會內供奉。

translations.literal: Prince Dan of Xiang, protector-general of the Pacified North and Pacifying-the-State Prince, became great general of the left and right thousand-ox guards and attended within on great court days.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dan of Xiang, protector of the north, became great general of the left and right thousand-ox guards and attended great audiences within the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙午，改秋社依舊用仲秋。

translations.literal: On bingwu the autumn she rite was restored to the mid-autumn month as of old.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the autumn she rite was fixed again in mid-autumn.

sentences.zh: 戊申，相王旦於太常㕔上。

translations.literal: On wushen Prince Dan at the Grand Temple reception hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Prince Dan took up his post at the Grand Temple reception hall.

sentences.zh: 王公諸親祖送，衛尉張設，光祿造食。

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, and kin escorted him; the minister of guests set the guard; the minister of provisions prepared the feast.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, dukes, and kin escorted him; the minister of guests set the guard and the minister of provisions the feast.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，賜物如衛王上洛州牧之儀。

translations.literal: When the rites were finished, gifts followed the ceremony for Prince Chongjun's assumption of the Luozhou governorship.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites ended, gifts followed the same scale as for Prince Chongjun's Luozhou governorship.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，端州尉魏元忠為衛尉卿、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on yichou, Wei Yuanzhong, captain of Duanzhou, became Minister of the Imperial Clan, equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on yichou, Wei Yuanzhong of Duanzhou became minister of the imperial clan of third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，左庶子韋安石為吏部尚書，太子賓客李懷遠為右散騎常侍，右庶子唐休璟為輔國大將軍，右庶子崔玄暐為特進、檢校益州大都督府長史、判都督事，右庶子、西留守、戶部尚書、弘農郡公楊再思為檢校揚州大都督府長史、判都督事，少詹事兼侍讀、國子祭酒祝欽明為刑部尚書：並依前知政事，以上在春宮故僚也。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Zuo Shuzi Wei Anshi became Minister of Personnel; Crown Prince Mentor Li Huaiyuan became Right Attendant-in-Ordinary; Right Aide Tang Xiujing became Pacifying-the-State Grand General; Right Aide Cui Xuanwei became Special Advance, chief administrator of the metropolitan prefecture of Yizhou, and acting governor; Right Aide Yang Zaisi, western intendant, Minister of Revenue, and Duke of Hongnong, became chief administrator of the metropolitan prefecture of Yangzhou and acting governor; Junior Mentor and Lecturer Zhu Qinming became Minister of Punishments—all retained participation in government as former staff of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Wei Anshi became minister of personnel; Li Huaiyuan right attendant; Tang Xiujing pacifying-the-state grand general; Cui Xuanwei special advance and acting governor of Yizhou; Yang Zaisi acting governor of Yangzhou; Zhu Qinming minister of punishments—all kept their seats on the council as the crown prince's former staff.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，張柬之為中書令。

translations.literal: On yihai Zhang Jianzhi became Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhang Jianzhi became secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，追贈邵王重潤為懿德太子。

translations.literal: On wuyin the late Prince Chongrun of Shao was posthumously created Virtuous Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the late Prince Chongrun of Shao was posthumously made Virtuous Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 同官縣大雨雹，燕雀多死，漂溺居人四百家，遣使賑給。

translations.literal: In Tongguan County a great hailstorm killed many swallows and sparrows, flooded four hundred households, and envoys were sent to grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Tongguan was struck by hail that killed birds by the flock, drowned four hundred households, and envoys were sent with relief.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，遷武氏七廟神主於西京崇尊廟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renwu, the spirit tablets of the seven Wu temples were moved to the Chongzun Temple in the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu, the Wu ancestral tablets were moved to Chongzun Temple in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 東都創置太廟社稷。

translations.literal: In the eastern capital the imperial ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain were newly established.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang gained a new imperial ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，制依舊以周、隋為二王後。

translations.literal: An edict restored Zhou and Sui as the two former dynasties, as of old.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored Zhou and Sui as the two former dynasties, as before.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，封成紀郡王千里為成王。

translations.literal: On renchen Prince Qianli of Chengji commandery was enfeoffed as Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Prince Qianli of Chengji was made Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，侍中敬暉封為平陽郡王；

translations.literal: On guisi Attendant-in-Chief Jing Hui was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyang commandery;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Jing Hui, attendant-in-chief, was made Prince of Pingyang;

sentences.zh: 侍中桓彥範扶陽郡王，賜姓韋氏；

translations.literal: Attendant-in-Chief Huan Yanfan as Prince of Fuyang commandery, granted the surname Wei;
translations.idiomatic: Huan Yanfan as Prince of Fuyang, granted the Wei surname;

sentences.zh: 中書令張柬之漢陽郡王；

translations.literal: Secretariat Director Zhang Jianzhi as Prince of Hanyang commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jianzhi as Prince of Hanyang;

sentences.zh: 中書令袁恕己南陽郡王；

translations.literal: Secretariat Director Yuan Shuji as Prince of Nanyang commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shuji as Prince of Nanyang;

sentences.zh: 特進崔玄暐海陵郡王；

translations.literal: Special Advance Cui Xuanwei as Prince of Hailing commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xuanwei as Prince of Hailing;

sentences.zh: 並加授特進，罷知政事。

translations.literal: all were given the special advance rank and ceased participation in government.
translations.idiomatic: all were made special advance and left the council.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書韋安石為兼中書令，兵部尚書魏元忠為兼侍中。

translations.literal: Wei Anshi, Minister of Personnel, became concurrent Secretariat Director; Wei Yuanzhong, Minister of War, became concurrent Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Anshi, minister of personnel, became concurrent secretariat director; Wei Yuanzhong, minister of war, concurrent attendant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，皇后表請天下士庶為出母為三年服，年二十二成丁，五十九免役。

translations.literal: The empress memorialized requesting that all commoners throughout the realm observe three years' mourning for a stepmother, that adulthood be fixed at twenty-two, and that corvée end at fifty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: The empress asked that commoners mourn a stepmother three years, that adulthood begin at twenty-two, and corvée end at fifty-nine.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，降梁王武三思為德靜郡王，定王武攸暨為樂壽郡王，河內王武懿宗等十餘人並降為國公。

translations.literal: On guimao Prince Sansi of Liang was demoted to Prince of Dejing commandery; Prince Youji of Ding to Prince of Leshou commandery; Prince Yizong of Henei and more than ten others were all demoted to dukes of states.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Wu Sansi was demoted to Prince of Dejing; Wu Youji to Prince of Leshou; Wu Yizong of Henei and a dozen others to state dukes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，特進、芮國公豆盧欽望為尚書左僕射，輔國大將軍、酒泉郡公唐休璟為尚書右僕射：依舊同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On jiachen Special Advance Dou Lu Qinwang became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Pacifying-the-State Grand General Tang Xiujing became Right Vice Director—both equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery, as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Dou Lu Qinwang became left vice minister of state and Tang Xiujing right vice minister, each of third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙午，制以鄒魯之邑百戶為太師、隆道公宣尼採邑，用供薦享。

translations.literal: An edict granted a hundred households in the lands of Zou and Lu as a fief for the Grand Master and Duke of Sagely Way Confucius to supply sacrifices,
translations.idiomatic: An edict set aside a hundred households in Zou and Lu to supply sacrifices for Confucius, grand master and duke of the sagely way,

sentences.zh: 又授裔孫褒聖侯崇基朝散大夫，仍許子孫傳襲。

translations.literal: and also appointed his descendant Chongji, Marquis Who Honors the Sage, as Palace Gentleman for Promotion of Virtue, with permission for his descendants to inherit in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: and made his descendant Chongji, marquis who honors the sage, a palace gentleman for promotion of virtue, inheritable in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，河北十七州大水，漂沒人居。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingsi, seventeen Hebei prefectures suffered great floods that drowned the people's dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingsi, seventeen Hebei prefectures flooded and drowned countless homes.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，尚書左僕射豆盧欽望，軍國重事中書門下可共平章；

translations.literal: On guihai Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Dou Lu Qinwang—on weighty matters of state the Secretariat and Chancellery may jointly deliberate;
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Dou Lu Qinwang, left vice minister—on weighty affairs the secretariat and chancellery might jointly deliberate;

sentences.zh: 檢校中書令韋安石中書令，兼檢校吏部尚書；

translations.literal: Acting Secretariat Director Wei Anshi became Secretariat Director and concurrent Minister of Personnel;
translations.idiomatic: acting director Wei Anshi became secretariat director and concurrent minister of personnel;

sentences.zh: 檢校侍中魏元忠兼檢校兵部尚書；

translations.literal: Acting Attendant-in-Chief Wei Yuanzhong became concurrent Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: acting attendant Wei Yuanzhong became concurrent minister of war;

sentences.zh: 楊再思兼戶部尚書，兼檢校中書令。

translations.literal: Yang Zaisi became concurrent Minister of Revenue and Acting Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaisi became concurrent minister of revenue and acting secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，祔孝敬皇帝神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingmao the spirit tablet of the Filial and Respectful Emperor was placed in the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the tablet of the Filial and Respectful Emperor entered the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 廟號義宗，非禮也。

translations.literal: The temple name Yizong was contrary to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The temple name Yizong violated ritual.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，洛水暴漲，壞廬舍二千餘家，溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: On wuchen the Luo River rose in flood and destroyed more than two thousand houses; the drowned were very many.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the Luo burst its banks, wrecked more than two thousand houses, and drowned a great multitude.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，太子賓客韋巨源同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on xinsi, Crown Prince Mentor Wei Juyuan became equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinsi, Wei Juyuan, crown prince mentor, joined the third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以特進、漢陽郡王張柬之為襄州刺史，仍不知州事。

translations.literal: On yiwei Special Advance Zhang Jianzhi, Duke of Hanyang, was made prefect of Xiangzhou, still without charge of prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Zhang Jianzhi, special advance and Duke of Hanyang, was sent to Xiangzhou as nominal prefect without governing authority.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，以水災，令文武官九品以上直言極諫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wushen, because of the flood disaster, civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above were ordered to remonstrate with utmost frankness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wushen, after the floods the emperor ordered officials of the ninth rank and above to remonstrate without reserve.

sentences.zh: 河南洛陽百姓被水兼損者給復一年。

translations.literal: The people of Henan and Luoyang who suffered flood damage were granted tax relief for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Henan and Luoyang flood victims received one year's tax relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，追冊故妃趙氏為恭皇后，尊孝敬妃裴氏為哀皇后。

translations.literal: On jiazi the late consort Zhao was posthumously created Respectful Empress, and the Filial and Respectful Consort Pei was honored as Lamenting Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the late Consort Zhao was made Respectful Empress and Consort Pei, mother of the Filial and Respectful Emperor, Lamenting Empress.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上親祔太祖景皇帝、獻祖光皇帝、世祖元皇帝、高祖神堯皇帝、皇祖太宗文武皇帝、皇孝高宗天皇大帝、皇兄義宗孝敬皇帝神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On yihai the emperor personally placed in the temple the spirit tablets of the Founding Ancestor, the Radiant Ancestor, the Primordial Ancestor, the Divine Yao Ancestor, the Literary and Martial Ancestor Taizong, the Filial and High Ancestor, and the Filial and Respectful Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the emperor personally enshrined the tablets from the founding ancestor through Gaozong and the Filial and Respectful Emperor.

sentences.zh: 皇后廟見。

translations.literal: The empress visited the empresses' temple.
translations.idiomatic: The empress visited the temple of empresses.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，御洛城南門觀斗象。

translations.literal: On dingchou he viewed the Dipper and constellations at the south gate of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he watched the stars at Luoyang's south gate.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，親祀明堂，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renwu, he personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, he sacrificed at the Bright Hall in person and proclaimed amnesty.

sentences.zh: 禁《化胡經》及婚娶之家父母親亡停喪成禮。

translations.literal: The Conversion of the Barbarians Sutra was forbidden, and among families marrying it was forbidden to suspend mourning when parents or parents-in-law died.
translations.idiomatic: The Conversion of the Barbarians Sutra was banned, and families were forbidden to skip mourning rites when parents or parents-in-law died.

sentences.zh: 天下大酺三日。

translations.literal: Public feasting throughout the realm for three days.
translations.idiomatic: The realm feasted for three days.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太子賓客韋巨源為禮部尚書，依舊知政事。

translations.literal: On wuxu Crown Prince Mentor Wei Juyuan became Minister of Rites, retaining participation in government.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Wei Juyuan became minister of rites while keeping his seat on the council.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，幸龍門香山寺。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on guihai, he visited Longmen Xiangshan Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on guihai, he went to Longmen Xiangshan Monastery.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸新安。

translations.literal: On yichou he visited Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he went to Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 改弘文館為修文館。

translations.literal: The Hongwen Institute was changed to the Cultivated Literature Institute.
translations.idiomatic: The Hongwen Institute was renamed the Cultivated Literature Institute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，魏元忠為中書令，楊再思為侍中。

translations.literal: On xinwei Wei Yuanzhong became Secretariat Director; Yang Zaisi became Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wei Yuanzhong became secretariat director and Yang Zaisi attendant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，加皇帝尊號曰應天，皇后尊號曰順天。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, the emperor's honorific was extended to Responsive-to-Heaven; the empress's to Obedient-to-Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, the emperor took the added title Responsive-to-Heaven and the empress Obedient-to-Heaven.

sentences.zh: 壬午，皇帝、皇后親謁太廟，告受徽號之意，大赦天下，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On renwu the emperor and empress personally visited the ancestral temple to announce the receipt of the honorifics; a general amnesty was proclaimed and feasting granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the emperor and empress announced their new titles at the ancestral temple, proclaimed amnesty, and feasted three days.

sentences.zh: 己丑，御洛城南門樓觀潑寒胡戲。

translations.literal: On jichou he viewed the Cold-Dispelling Hu play from the south gate tower of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he watched the Cold-Dispelling Hu play from Luoyang's south gate tower.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，衛王重俊為左衛大將軍，遙領揚州大都督；

translations.literal: On xinchou Prince Chongjun of Wei became left guard general and from afar military governor of Yangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Prince Chongjun of Wei became left guard general and titular governor of Yangzhou;

sentences.zh: 溫王重茂為右衛大將軍，遙領並州大都督。

translations.literal: Prince Chongmao of Wen became right guard general and from afar military governor of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chongmao of Wen became right guard general and titular governor of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，則天皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On renyin the Great Sage Emperor Zetian died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Empress Zetian died.

sentences.zh: 神龍二年二年春正月丙申，護則天靈駕還京。

translations.literal: In the first spring month of Shenlong 2, on bingchen, the late empress's coffin was escorted back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of Shenlong 2, on bingchen, Zetian's coffin was escorted back to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，吏部尚書李嶠同中書門下三品，中書侍郎於惟謙同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On wuxu Li Qiao, Minister of Personnel, became equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery; Vice Minister of the Secretariat Yu Weiqian became equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery as associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Li Qiao, minister of personnel, and Yu Weiqian, secretariat vice minister, joined the third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午朔，置公主府官員。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on bingwu, the new moon, staff were established for princesses' households.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingwu at the new moon, princesses' households were given official staffs.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以特進敬暉、桓彥範、袁恕己等三人為滑、洺、豫刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao Special Advances Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, and Yuan Shuji were made prefects of Hua, Ming, and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, and Yuan Shuji were sent out as prefects of Hua, Ming, and Yu.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，刑部尚書韋巨源同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yiwei, Wei Juyuan, Minister of Punishments, became equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, Wei Juyuan, minister of punishments, joined the third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 遣十使巡察風俗。

translations.literal: Ten envoys were dispatched to inspect customs throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Ten envoys were sent to inspect customs empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丙申，僧會範、道士史崇玄等十餘人授官封公，以常賞聖善寺功也。

translations.literal: On bingchen more than ten monks including Huifan and Daoist Shi Chongxuan were granted offices and enfeoffed as dukes, as a routine reward for work on the Sagely Goodness Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the monk Huifan, the Daoist Shi Chongxuan, and more than ten others were given offices and dukedoms for routine work on the Sagely Goodness Monastery.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，中書令韋安石為戶部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiachen, Wei Anshi, Secretariat Director, became Minister of Revenue and ceased participation in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiachen, Wei Anshi left the council to become minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書蘇瑰為侍中、京留守。

translations.literal: Su Gui, Minister of Revenue, became Attendant-in-Chief and Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Su Gui, minister of revenue, became attendant-in-chief and capital intendant.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，黃霧四塞。

translations.literal: On yisi yellow fog filled the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi yellow fog shrouded the horizon.

sentences.zh: 唐休璟請致仕，許之。

translations.literal: Tang Xiujing requested retirement; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Xiujing asked to retire and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，殺光祿卿、駙馬都尉王同皎。

translations.literal: On gengxu Wang Tongjiao, Director of the Office of the Imperial Sons-in-Law and commandant-consort, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wang Tongjiao, director of the office of imperial sons-in-law, was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，洛陽城東七里許，地色如水，側近樹木、往來車馬歷歷影見水中，經月餘乃滅。

translations.literal: On renzi, about seven li east of Luoyang city, the ground had the color of water; nearby trees and passing carriages and horses cast clear reflections in it as in water; after more than a month it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, seven li east of Luoyang, the earth shone like water and trees and carts cast mirror-clear reflections for more than a month.

sentences.zh: 是月，大置員外官，自京諸司及諸州佐凡二千餘人，超授閹官七品已上及員外者千餘人。

translations.literal: That month supernumerary officials were greatly increased: from capital offices and all prefectural aides more than two thousand in all; more than a thousand eunuchs of the seventh rank and above and supernumeraries were abruptly promoted.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court flooded the ranks with more than two thousand supernumeraries from capital and provinces and abruptly promoted more than a thousand eunuchs of the seventh rank and above.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，贈后父韋玄貞太師、益州都督。

translations.literal: On renxu the empress's late father Xuanzhen was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and military governor of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the empress's father Xuanzhen was posthumously made grand preceptor and governor of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，又贈玄貞為酆王，玄貞弟四人並贈郡王。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on jiaxu, Xuanzhen was again posthumously made Prince of Feng; his four younger brothers were all posthumously made commandery princes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on jiaxu, Xuanzhen was made posthumous Prince of Feng and four younger brothers posthumous commandery princes.

sentences.zh: 己卯，左散騎常侍、同中書門下三品李懷遠請致仕，許之。

translations.literal: On jimao Zuo Sanqi Changshi Li Huaiyuan requested retirement; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Huaiyuan, left sanqi attendant, retired with permission.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，洛水暴漲，壞天津橋。

translations.literal: On xinsi the Luo River rose in flood and destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Luo in flood wrecked the Tianjin Bridge.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，特進、朗州刺史、平陽郡王敬暉貶崖州司馬，特進、毫州刺史、扶陽郡王桓彥範瀧州司馬，特進、郢州刺史袁恕己竇州司馬，特進、均州刺史、博陵郡王崔玄暐白州司馬，特進、襄州刺史、漢陽郡王張柬之新州司馬，並員外置，長任，舊官封爵並追奪。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuyin, Special Advance Jing Hui, Duke of Pingyang and prefect of Lang, was demoted to military affairs officer of Yazhou; Special Advance Huan Yanfan, Duke of Fuyang and prefect of Bozhou, to military affairs officer of Longzhou; Special Advance Yuan Shuji, prefect of E, to military affairs officer of Douzhou; Special Advance Cui Xuanwei, Duke of Boling and prefect of Jun, to military affairs officer of Baizhou; Special Advance Zhang Jianzhi, Duke of Hanyang and prefect of Xiang, to military affairs officer of Xin—all supernumerary appointments, long tenure, and former offices, titles, and fiefs were posthumously stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuyin, the five restoration heroes—Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, Yuan Shuji, Cui Xuanwei, and Zhang Jianzhi—were demoted to petty frontier posts as supernumeraries for life, and their old honors and fiefs were stripped.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，立衛王重俊為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on bingwu, Prince Chongjun of Wei was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingwu, Prince Chongjun of Wei was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，中書令兼檢校兵部尚書齊國公魏元忠為尚書右僕射兼中書令，仍知兵部事；

translations.literal: On bingyin Secretariat Director and concurrent Minister of War Wei Yuanzhong, Duke of Qi, became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Secretariat Director, still in charge of war;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wei Yuanzhong, secretariat director and Duke of Qi, became right vice minister of state and kept the secretariat and war portfolios;

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書李嶠為中書令；

translations.literal: Li Qiao, Minister of Personnel, became Secretariat Director;
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiao became secretariat director;

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書韋巨源為吏部尚書，依舊同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Wei Juyuan, Minister of Punishments, became Minister of Personnel, retaining equal rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Juyuan became minister of personnel while keeping his third rank at the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禮部尚書祝欽明為中丞蕭至忠所劾。

translations.literal: On gengwu Zhu Qinming, Minister of Rites, was impeached by Censor-in-Chief Xiao Zhizhong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhu Qinming, minister of rites, was impeached by Xiao Zhizhong, censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 前左散騎常侍李懷遠為左散騎常侍、同中書門下三品、東都留守。

translations.literal: The former Left Sanqi Changshi Li Huaiyuan became Left Sanqi Changshi, equal in rank to the Three Offices at the Secretariat Chancellery, and Eastern Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaiyuan returned as left sanqi attendant of third rank and eastern capital intendant.

sentences.zh: 九月，祝欽明貶青州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Zhu Qinming was demoted to prefect of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhu Qinming was demoted to Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸白馬寺。

translations.literal: On renyin he visited Baima Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he went to Baima Monastery.

sentences.zh: 戊午，左散騎常侍李懷遠卒。

translations.literal: On wuwu Left Sanqi Changshi Li Huaiyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Li Huaiyuan died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，置戶部侍郎一員。

translations.literal: On renyin one post of Vice Minister of Revenue was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a second vice minister of revenue was established.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，車駕還京師。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on jimao, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on jimao, the court returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，至自東都。

translations.literal: On wuxu he arrived from the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he arrived from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，大赦天下，行從文武官賜勛一轉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yisi, a general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials in the procession received one turn on the merit roll.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yisi, the court proclaimed amnesty and granted one merit turn to officials in the cortège.

sentences.zh: 改河南為合宮，洛陽為永昌，嵩陽為登封，陽城為告成。

translations.literal: Henan was renamed Hegong, Luoyang Yongchang, Songyang Dengfeng, and Yangcheng Gaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: Henan became Hegong, Luoyang Yongchang, Songyang Dengfeng, and Yangcheng Gaocheng.

sentences.zh: 戊午，兼秘書鄭普思坐妖逆配流儋州，其黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On wuwu Zheng Pusi, concurrent secretary of the Secretariat, was banished to Danzhou for sorcery and treason; his faction was all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zheng Pusi, acting secretariat secretary, was exiled to Danzhou for sorcery; his faction was executed to the last man.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，突厥默啜寇靈州鳴沙縣，靈武軍大總管沙吒忠義逆擊之，官軍敗績，死者三萬。

translations.literal: On jimao the Turkic khan Mojilie raided Mingsha County in Ling Prefecture; Shazha Zhongyi, grand general of the Lingwu Army, met him in battle; the government army was defeated and thirty thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Turk Mojilie raided Mingsha in Ling; Shazha Zhongyi of the Lingwu army met him and lost thirty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，突厥進寇原、會等州，掠隴右牧馬萬餘而去。

translations.literal: On dingsi the Turks advanced to raid Yuan and Hui and other prefectures, seizing more than ten thousand horses from the Longyou stud farms before withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Turks raided Yuan, Hui, and neighboring prefectures and drove off more than ten thousand Longyou horses.

sentences.zh: 甲申，募能斬默啜者，封授諸大衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiashen anyone who could slay Mojilie was to be enfeoffed and granted the rank of great general of the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the throne promised enfeoffment and guard general rank to whoever could kill Mojilie.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以突厥犯邊，京師亢旱，令減膳徹樂。

translations.literal: On bingxu, because the Turks violated the frontier and the capital suffered severe drought, the court ordered reduced meals and suspended music.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, with Turks on the border and Chang'an in drought, the court ate sparingly and silenced the music.

sentences.zh: 河北水，大饑，命侍中蘇瑰存撫賑給。

translations.literal: In Hebei great floods brought famine; Attendant-in-Chief Su Gui was ordered to comfort and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei flooded and starved; Su Gui, attendant-in-chief, was sent to comfort and relieve.

sentences.zh: 丙申，特進、尚書左僕射、兼安國相王府長史、芮國公豆盧欽望為開府儀同三司，依舊平章軍國重事；

translations.literal: On bingchen Special Advance Dou Lu Qinwang, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent chief administrator of the Pacifying-the-State Prince of Xiang's household and Duke of Ruiguo, became Palace Minister of the First Rank, retaining deliberation on weighty military and state affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Dou Lu Qinwang became palace minister of the first rank while still deliberating weighty state affairs;

sentences.zh: 尚書右僕射兼中書令、知兵部事、齊國公魏元忠為尚書左僕射兼中書令，仍兼知兵部事。

translations.literal: Wei Yuanzhong, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Secretariat Director, in charge of war, Duke of Qi, became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Secretariat Director, still in charge of war.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuanzhong moved to left vice minister of state while keeping the secretariat and war portfolios.

sentences.zh: 是冬，牛大疫。

translations.literal: That winter cattle suffered a great epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: That winter a plague killed cattle across the realm.

sentences.zh: 景龍元年三年春正月庚子朔，不受朝會，喪未再期也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jinglong, on gengzi, the new moon, he did not hold court; mourning had not yet reached the second anniversary.
translations.idiomatic: In Jinglong 1, on the gengzi new moon of the first spring month, he held no audience; mourning for Zetian had not yet completed two years.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以默啜寇邊，制募猛士武藝超絕者，各令自舉，內外群官各進破滅突厥之策。

translations.literal: On gengxu, because Mojilie raided the frontier, an edict recruited men of surpassing martial skill to nominate themselves, and civil and military officials within and without were each to submit plans for destroying the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, with Mojilie raiding, the throne called for self-nominated warriors and asked every official for plans to crush the Turks.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以旱，親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On bingchen, because of drought, he personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, in drought, he reviewed prisoners in person.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣武攸暨、武三思往乾陵祈雨於則天皇后，既而雨降，上大感悅。

translations.literal: On jisi Wu Youji and Wu Sansi were sent to Qianling to pray for rain at the tomb of Empress Zetian; rain then fell, and the emperor was deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wu Youji and Wu Sansi prayed for rain at Zetian's tomb at Qianling; when rain fell the emperor was deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，制武氏崇恩廟依舊享祭，仍置五品令、七品丞，其昊陵、順陵置令、丞如廟。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinwei, an edict restored sacrifices at the Wu Chong'en Temple as of old, with fifth-rank directors and seventh-rank aides; the Hao and Shun tombs likewise received directors and aides as at a temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei, the Wu Chong'en Temple sacrifices were restored with fifth-rank directors and seventh-rank aides, and the Hao and Shun tombs staffed likewise.

sentences.zh: 壬午，贈太師、酆王廟號褒德，陵號榮先，置六品令、八品丞。

translations.literal: On renwu the late Grand Preceptor and Prince of Feng was given the temple name Lauding Virtue and the tomb name Glorious Ancestor, with sixth-rank directors and eighth-rank aides.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the late Prince of Feng was temple-named Lauding Virtue and tomb-named Glorious Ancestor, with sixth-rank directors and eighth-rank aides.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，改中興寺、觀為龍興，內外不得言「中興」。

translations.literal: On gengyin monasteries and abbeys named Restoration were changed to Dragon Rise; within and without it was forbidden to speak of "restoration."
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Restoration monasteries and abbeys were renamed Dragon Rise, and the word restoration was banned.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸安樂公主宅。

translations.literal: On xinmao he visited Princess Anle's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he visited Princess Anle's mansion.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，吐蕃贊普遣大臣悉董熱獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingzi, the Tibetan king sent the minister Xidongre with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi, Tibet sent the minister Xidongre with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是春，自京師至山東疾疫，民死者眾。

translations.literal: That spring, from the capital to Shandong pestilence raged and the people died in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: That spring plague swept from Chang'an to Shandong and killed multitudes.

sentences.zh: 河北、河南大旱。

translations.literal: In Hebei and Henan there was great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei and Henan suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，以嗣雍王守禮女為金城公主，出降吐蕃贊普。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on xinsi, the daughter of the Prince of Yong, heir of the deposed line, was made Princess Jincheng and sent to marry the Tibetan king.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on xinsi, Prince Shouli's daughter was made Princess Jincheng and sent to marry the Tibetan king.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸薦福寺，曲赦雍州。

translations.literal: On gengyin he visited Jianfu Monastery and granted a special amnesty to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he went to Jianfu Monastery and granted a special amnesty to Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，左屯衛大將軍兼檢校洛州長史張仁亶為朔方道大總管，以備突厥。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuxu, Zhang Renbian, left general of the Left Garrison Guard and concurrent acting prefect of Luozhou, became grand general of the Shuofang circuit to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuxu, Zhang Renbian, left garrison general and acting Luozhou prefect, became Shuofang grand general against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 丙午，突厥默啜殺我行人臧思言。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Mo-ch'o of the Turks slew our envoy Zang Siyan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Turk qaghan Mo-chu murdered the court envoy Zang Siyan.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯逆，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingmao new moon: the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingmao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，姚雋道討擊使、侍御史唐九徵擊姚州叛蠻，破之，俘虜三千計，遂於其處勒石紀功焉。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Pacification Commissioner of Yaoxian Circuit Tang Jiuzheng, also investigating censor, attacked the rebel tribes of Yaozhou, defeated them, and took some three thousand captives; he then set up a stone there to record the achievement.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Tang Jiuzheng, pacification commissioner of Yaoxian circuit and investigating censor, crushed the Yaozhou rebels, took some three thousand captives, and had the victory carved in stone on the spot.

sentences.zh: 是夏，山東、河北二十餘州旱，饑饉疾疫死者數千計，遣使賑恤之。

translations.literal: That summer more than twenty circuits in Shandong and Hebei suffered drought; famine and pestilence killed thousands. Envoys were sent to relieve and comfort the people.
translations.idiomatic: That summer drought struck more than twenty prefectures in Shandong and Hebei; famine and plague killed thousands, and the court sent envoys with relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，皇太子重俊與羽林將軍李多祚等，率羽林千騎兵三百餘人，誅武三思、武崇訓，遂引兵自肅章門斬關而入。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengzi: Crown Prince Chongjun, with Yulin General Li Duozuo and others, led more than three hundred Yulin thousand-horse guards, executed Wu Sansi and Wu Chongxun, then led troops through the Suozhang Gate, cutting the bar to enter.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengzi, Crown Prince Chongjun and Yulin general Li Duozuo led over three hundred elite guards, killed Wu Sansi and Wu Chongxun, then forced the Suozhang Gate and burst into the palace.

sentences.zh: 帝惶遽登玄武樓，重俊引兵至下，上自臨軒諭之，眾遂散去，殺李多祚。

translations.literal: The Emperor in alarm ascended the Xuanwu Tower; Chongjun led troops below. The Emperor himself leaned from the balustrade to address them, and the host dispersed; Li Duozuo was killed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fled in panic to the Xuanwu Tower. Chongjun brought his men beneath the balcony; the emperor leaned out to reason with them, the soldiers melted away, and Li Duozuo was slain.

sentences.zh: 重俊出奔至鄠縣，為部下所殺。

translations.literal: Chongjun fled to Hu County; he was killed by his own followers.
translations.idiomatic: Chongjun fled toward Hu County and was killed by his own men.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On guimao a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，改玄武門為神武門，樓為制勝樓。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingzi: Xuanwu Gate was renamed Divine Martial Gate, the tower renamed Tower of Sure Victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi, Xuanwu Gate was renamed Divine Martial Gate and its tower Tower of Sure Victory.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，左僕射兼中書令魏元忠請致仕，授特進。

translations.literal: On bingxu Left Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrently Left Director Wei Yuanzhong requested retirement; he was granted specially advanced rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Wei Yuanzhong, left vice director of the Secretariat, asked to retire and was made specially advanced.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，兵部尚書、郢國公宗楚客，左衛將軍兼太府卿紀處訥並同中書門下三品；

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingyou: Minister of War and Prince of Ying Zong Chuke, and Left Guard General concurrently Grand Steward Ji Chuna were both made co-equal with the Secretariat third grade;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou, Zong Chuke, minister of war and Prince of Ying, and Ji Chuna, left guard general and grand steward, entered the Secretariat as co-equal third-grade ministers;

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎兼左御史臺中丞蕭至忠為黃門侍郎兼左御史中丞、同中書門下三品；

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Left Bureau Xiao Zhi Zhong became Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Left, co-equal with the Secretariat third grade;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zhi Zhong, vice director of personnel and left vice censor-in-chief, was made vice director of the Yellow Gate with the same standing;

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎、東海郡公於惟謙國子祭酒，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Donghai Yu Wei Qian was made Rector of the Directorate of Education and ceased managing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Wei Qian, vice director of the Secretariat and Duke of Donghai, was made rector of the Directorate of Education and left the council of state.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上皇帝尊號曰應天神龍，皇后尊號曰順天翊聖，大赦天下，改元為景龍。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Emperor's honorific was raised to Responsive Spirit Divine Dragon; the Empress's to Compliant Heaven Aiding Sage. A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Jinglong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor took the honorific Responsive Spirit Divine Dragon and the empress Compliant Heaven Aiding Sage; the realm was amnestied and the era renamed Jinglong.

sentences.zh: 兩京文武官，三品已上賜爵一級，四品已下加一階，外官賜勛一轉。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of the two capitals of third rank and above were granted one noble rank; those of fourth rank and below received one step; outer officials one turn of merit.
translations.idiomatic: At the two capitals, officials of third rank and above gained a noble rank, those of fourth rank and below a step in rank, and outer officials one turn of merit.

sentences.zh: 景龍元年九月甲辰，特進魏元忠左授務川尉，言與重俊通謀也。

translations.literal: Jinglong, first year, ninth month, jiachen: Specially Advanced Wei Yuanzhong was demoted to Wuchuan county magistrate, on the charge of plotting with Chongjun.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Jinglong, on jiachen, Wei Yuanzhong was stripped of specially advanced rank and sent to serve as magistrate of Wuchuan, accused of collusion with Chongjun.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，侍中兼左御史臺大夫楊再思為中書令，吏部尚書韋巨源、太府卿紀處訥並為侍中，侍中蘇瑰為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On gengchen Attendant-in-Chief and concurrently Left Censor-in-Chief Yang Zaisi became Director of the Secretariat; Minister of Personnel Wei Juyuan and Grand Steward Ji Chuna became attendants-in-chief; Attendant-in-Chief Su Gui became Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Yang Zaisi became director of the Secretariat; Wei Juyuan and Ji Chuna, attendants-in-chief; Su Gui, minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改左右羽林衛千騎為萬騎，仍分為左右。

translations.literal: On renxu the Left and Right Yulin Guards' thousand-horse units were renamed Ten Thousand Horse units and again divided into left and right.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Yulin thousand-horse guards were renamed Ten Thousand Horse regiments, each split into left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，彗見於西，月餘而滅。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, renwu: a comet appeared in the west and was extinguished after more than a month.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on renwu, a comet blazed in the west for more than a month.

sentences.zh: 壬午，皇后上《神武頌》，令兩京及四大都督府皆刻之於石。

translations.literal: On renwu the Empress submitted the "Ode to Divine Martiality" and ordered it carved in stone at the two capitals and the four great protectorates.
translations.idiomatic: That same renwu the empress presented the "Ode to Divine Martiality" and had it cut into stone at the two capitals and the four great protectorates.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yichou new moon: the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the twelfth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，京師雨土。

translations.literal: On dingchou earth rained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou dust fell like rain over the capital.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年二年春正月丙申，滄州雨雹，大如雞卵。

translations.literal: Jinglong, second year, first month, bingshen: in Cangzhou hail as large as hen's eggs fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Jinglong, on bingshen, hailstones as large as hen's eggs struck Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，幸左金吾大將軍、陳國公陸頌宅。

translations.literal: Second month, xinwei: the Emperor visited the residence of Left Golden Guard Grand General and Duke of Chen Lu Song.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the second month the emperor visited Lu Song, left golden guard grand general and Duke of Chen.

sentences.zh: 皇后自言衣箱中裙上有五色雲起，令畫工圖之，以示百僚，乃大赦天下。

translations.literal: The Empress said that on a skirt in her wardrobe five-colored clouds had risen; she had a painter depict it and showed it to the hundred officials, then proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: The empress claimed five-colored clouds had risen from a skirt in her wardrobe, had the omen painted for the court, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸未夜，天保星墜西南，有聲如雷，野雉皆雊。

translations.literal: On guiwei night the Celestial Treasure star fell in the southwest with a sound like thunder; wild pheasants all crowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiwei the Celestial Treasure star plunged southwest with a thunderous roar, and wild pheasants cried out across the fields.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，帝以后服有慶雲之瑞，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On yiyou, because the empress's robes bore the auspicious sign of felicitous clouds, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, citing felicitous clouds on the empress's robes, the throne again amnestied the realm.

sentences.zh: 內外五品已上母妻各加邑號一等，無妻者聽授女；

translations.literal: Mothers and wives of officials within and without of fifth rank and above each received one step in noble title; those without wives might confer it on a daughter;
translations.idiomatic: Within and without the court, mothers and wives of officials of fifth rank and above gained a noble title; the wifeless might pass the honor to a daughter;

sentences.zh: 天下婦人八十已上，版授鄉、縣、郡等君。

translations.literal: every woman in the realm eighty years and above was granted by patent the title of district, county, or commandery lady.
translations.idiomatic: and every woman in the realm eighty or older was granted a patent as district, county, or commandery lady.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，朔方道大總管張仁亶築受降城於河上。

translations.literal: Third month, bingzi: Zhang Renyuan, grand commander of Shuofang circuit, built the Accepting Surrender fortress on the river.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the third month Zhang Renyuan, grand commander of Shuofang, built Accepting Surrender fortress on the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，左散騎常侍、樂壽郡王、駙馬都尉武攸暨讓郡王，改封楚國公。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengwu: Left Regular Attendant, Prince of Leshou, and Chief Commandant of Horse for the Imperial Son-in-Law Wu Youji yielded the princedom and was re-enfeoffed Duke of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the fourth summer month Wu Youji, left regular attendant, Prince of Leshou, and chief commandant for imperial sons-in-law, surrendered his princedom and was made Duke of Chu.

sentences.zh: 癸未，修文館增置大學士八員，直學士十二員。

translations.literal: On guiwei the Cultivation of Letters Hall added eight grand academicians and twelve direct academicians.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei eight grand academicians and twelve direct academicians were added to the Cultivation of Letters Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸長樂公主莊，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On jichou the Emperor visited Princess Changle's estate and returned to the palace the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he visited Princess Changle's villa and returned to the palace that day.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，改太史局為太史監，罷隸秘書省。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dinghai: the Astrological Service was renamed the Astrological Bureau and removed from the Secretariat's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the sixth month the Astrological Service became the Astrological Bureau, no longer subordinate to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，臺州地震。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, xinmao: Taizhou was struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinmao, Taizhou suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，左屯衛大將軍、攝右御史臺大夫、朔方道行營大總管、韓國公張仁亶同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On guisi Left Encampment Guard Grand General, acting Right Censor-in-Chief, and Shuofang field commander Duke of Han Zhang Renyuan was made co-equal with the Secretariat third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zhang Renyuan, left encampment grand general, acting right censor-in-chief, and Shuofang commander, Duke of Han, entered the Secretariat as co-equal third grade.

sentences.zh: 有赤氣竟天，其光燭地，經三日乃止。

translations.literal: Crimson vapor stretched across the sky, its light illuminating the earth; after three days it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Crimson light spanned the heavens and lit the earth for three days before it faded.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月庚申，突厥首領娑葛叛，自立為可汗，遣弟遮弩率眾犯塞。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, winter, gengshen: the Turk leader Suoge rebelled, installed himself qaghan, and sent his younger brother Zhenu to lead troops in raiding the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the eleventh winter month the Turk chief Suoge rebelled, declared himself qaghan, and sent his brother Zhenu to raid the borders.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以安樂公主出降，假皇后仗出於禁中，以盛其儀，帝及后御安福樓以觀之。

translations.literal: On jimao, because Princess Anle was sent in marriage, the empress's ceremonial guard was lent from within the palace to magnify the spectacle; the Emperor and Empress mounted Peace and Blessing Tower to watch.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, for Princess Anle's wedding procession, the empress lent her ceremonial guard from the inner palace to swell the display; emperor and empress watched from Peace and Blessing Tower.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，大赦天下，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete a general amnesty was proclaimed and revelry granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites ended the court amnestied the realm and granted three days of public revelry.

sentences.zh: 癸未，安西都護牛師獎與娑葛戰於火燒城，師獎敗績，沒於陣。

translations.literal: On guiwei Protector-General of Anxi Niu Shiji fought Suoge at Fire-Burning City; Shiji was defeated and fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Niu Shiji, protector-general of Anxi, met Suoge at Fire-Burning City, was routed, and died on the field.

sentences.zh: 是冬，西京吏部置兩侍郎銓試，東都又置兩銓，恣行囑請。

translations.literal: That winter the Ministry of Personnel at the western capital set up two vice directors for examination; the eastern capital also set up two examiners, who freely sold their favor.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the western capital's Ministry of Personnel doubled its examining vice directors; the eastern capital added two more, and posts were openly traded for bribes.

sentences.zh: 又有斜封授官，預用秋闕。

translations.literal: There were also slanting-seal appointments, drawing on the autumn quota in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Slanting-seal appointments also preempted the autumn quota of offices.

sentences.zh: 景龍三年三年春正月丁卯，黃霧四塞。

translations.literal: Jinglong, third year, first month, spring, dingmao: yellow mist sealed the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of the third year of Jinglong, on dingmao, yellow fog choked the horizon.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸薦福寺。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Emperor visited Jianfu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he visited Jianfu Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宴侍臣及近親於梨園亭。

translations.literal: On yihai he feasted close ministers and kin at Pear Garden Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he banqueted close ministers and kin at Pear Garden Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，幸玄武門，與近臣觀宮女大酺，既而左右分曹，共爭勝負。
