translations.literal: Second month, jichou: he visited the Divine Martial Gate, watched palace women in great revelry with close ministers, then had left and right cohorts compete for victory.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the second month he went to Divine Martial Gate, watched palace women revel with his intimates, then set left and right factions to compete.

sentences.zh: 上又遣宮女為市肆，鬻賣眾物，令宰臣及公卿為商賈，與之交易，因為忿爭，言辭猥褻。

translations.literal: The Emperor also had palace women set up market stalls to sell goods, ordered chief ministers and dukes to act as merchants and trade with them, and quarrels arose with foul and lewd words.
translations.idiomatic: He had palace women open market stalls, made chief ministers and dukes haggle as merchants, and quarrels broke out in foul, lewd speech.

sentences.zh: 上與后觀之，以為笑樂。

translations.literal: The Emperor and Empress watched and took it for laughter.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor and empress looked on and laughed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，侍中、舒國公韋巨源為尚書左僕射，並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On renyin Attendant-in-Chief and Duke of Shu Wei Juyuan was made Left Director of the Secretariat, co-equal with the Secretariat third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wei Juyuan, attendant-in-chief and Duke of Shu, became left director of the Secretariat with third-grade standing.

sentences.zh: 戊午，兵部尚書、郢國公宗楚客中書令，中書侍郎、酂國公蕭至忠為侍中，太府卿韋嗣立為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品，中書侍郎、檢校吏部侍郎崔湜同中書門下平章事，兵部侍郎趙彥昭為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On wuwu Minister of War and Duke of Ying Zong Chuke became Director of the Secretariat; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Zan Xiao Zhi Zhong became Attendant-in-Chief; Grand Steward Wei Sili became Minister of War, co-equal with the Secretariat third grade; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Acting Vice Director of Personnel Cui Shi was made co-equal with the Secretariat as Rectifier; Vice Director of War Zhao Yanzhao became Vice Director of the Secretariat, co-equal with the Secretariat as Rectifier.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zong Chuke became director of the Secretariat; Xiao Zhi Zhong, attendant-in-chief; Wei Sili, minister of war with third-grade council standing; Cui Shi and Zhao Yanzhao entered as rectifiers of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚申，日赤紫色，無光。

translations.literal: On gengshen the sun was reddish purple and without light.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the sun turned reddish purple and dim.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，禮部尚書兼揚州大都督、曹國公韋溫為太子少保兼揚州大都督、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On wuyin Minister of Rites and concurrently Governor-General of Yangzhou and Duke of Cao Wei Wen was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, concurrently Governor-General of Yangzhou, co-equal with the Secretariat third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Wei Wen, minister of rites and governor-general of Yangzhou, Duke of Cao, was made junior tutor of the heir apparent with the same Yangzhou command and council standing.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿兼檢校吏部侍郎鄭愔同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Acting Vice Director of Personnel Zheng Yin was made co-equal with the Secretariat as Rectifier.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yin, vice director of imperial sacrifices and acting vice director of personnel, joined the council as rectifier.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙戌，崔湜、鄭愔坐贓，湜貶襄州刺史，愔貶江州司馬。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, bingxu: Cui Shi and Zheng Yin were convicted of corruption; Shi was demoted to prefect of Xiangzhou, Yin to military adjutant of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the fifth summer month Cui Shi and Zheng Yin were found corrupt; Shi was sent to Xiangzhou as prefect, Yin to Jiangzhou as adjutant.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，太白晝見於東井。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guichou: Venus appeared by day in the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the sixth month Venus shone by day in the Well.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以經籍多缺，使天下搜括。

translations.literal: On gengzi, because many classics were missing, a search was ordered throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, with canonical texts widely lost, the throne ordered a empire-wide search.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以旱，避正殿，減膳，親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On renyin, because of drought, he left the main hall, reduced his meals, and personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, for drought, he quit the main hall, ate sparingly, and heard criminal cases in person.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，尚書右僕射楊再思薨。

translations.literal: On guimao Right Director of the Secretariat Yang Zaisi died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yang Zaisi, right director of the Secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯朔，鎮軍大將軍、右驍衛將軍、兼知太史事迦業至忠配流柳州。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yimao new moon: General of the Garrison Army, Right Valiant Cavalry General, and concurrently in charge of the Astrological Service Xiao Zhi Zhong was banished to Liuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the seventh month Xiao Zhi Zhong, garrison general and right valiant cavalry commander, was banished to Liuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，娑葛遣使來降。

translations.literal: On bingchen Suoge sent envoys to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Suoge sent envoys to submit.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸梨園亭，宴侍臣學士。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Emperor visited Pear Garden Pavilion and feasted scholar-officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he banqueted scholar-officials at Pear Garden Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 皇后表請諸婦人不因夫子而加邑號者，許同見任職事官，聽子孫用廕，從之。

translations.literal: The Empress memorialized that women who did not receive noble titles through husband or son should, like serving officials, be allowed to use their sons' yin privilege; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The empress asked that women without titles from husband or son might, like officeholders, use their sons' yin privilege; the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，安福門外設無遮齋，三品已上行香。

translations.literal: On renxu outside Peace and Blessing Gate an unbounded Buddhist offering was set up; officials of third rank and above went to burn incense.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu a boundless Buddhist offering was held outside Peace and Blessing Gate; officials of third rank and above burned incense.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，御承慶殿，錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On guihai he presided at Chengqing Hall and reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he reviewed prisoners at Chengqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣使冊驍衛大將軍、兼衛尉卿、金河王突騎施守忠為歸化可汗。

translations.literal: On renwu envoys were sent to invest Valiant Cavalry Grand General, concurrently Commandant of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and Prince of Jinhe Turgesh Shouzhong as Qaghan Submitting to Transformation.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu envoys invested Turgesh Shouzhong, valiant cavalry grand general and prince of Jinhe, as Qaghan Submitting to Transformation.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，特進、行中書令、趙國公李嶠為特進、同中書門下三品，侍中、酂國公蕭至忠為中書令，特進、鄖國公韋安石為侍中。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yiyou: Specially Advanced and Acting Director of the Secretariat Duke of Zhao Li Qiao was made specially advanced, co-equal with the Secretariat third grade; Attendant-in-Chief and Duke of Zan Xiao Zhi Zhong became Director of the Secretariat; Specially Advanced and Duke of Yun Wei Anshi became Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Li Qiao remained specially advanced with council standing; Xiao Zhi Zhong became director of the Secretariat; Wei Anshi, attendant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，諸州各置司田參軍一員。

translations.literal: On gengyin each circuit was to place one agricultural inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin every circuit received one agricultural inspector.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃贊普遣使勃祿星奉進國信、贊普祖娑進物，及上中宮、安國相王、太平公主有差。

translations.literal: The Tibetan king sent envoy Boluoxing with state gifts, the late king's dowry goods, and separate gifts for the inner palace, the Prince of An'guo, the Prince of Xiang, and Princess Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan king sent Boluoxing with tribute, the late king's bridal goods, and separate gifts for the inner palace, the Prince of An'guo, the Prince of Xiang, and Princess Taiping.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣十使巡察天下。

translations.literal: On renchen ten envoys were dispatched to inspect the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen ten inspection envoys were sent through the empire.

sentences.zh: 有星孛於紫宮。

translations.literal: A broom star appeared in the Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: A comet swept the Purple Palace constellation.

sentences.zh: 令特進佩魚。

translations.literal: Specially advanced officials were ordered to wear fish insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Specially advanced officials were granted fish insignia.

sentences.zh: 散職佩魚，自此始也。

translations.literal: Dispersed-office holders wearing fish insignia began from this.
translations.idiomatic: From this date dispersed-office holders also wore the fish tally.

sentences.zh: 乙未，親送朔方軍總管、韓國公張仁亶於通化門外，上制序賦詩。

translations.literal: On yiwei the Emperor in person escorted Shuofang commander Duke of Han Zhang Renyuan beyond Tonghua Gate, composing a preface and poems.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he personally escorted Zhang Renyuan, Shuofang commander and Duke of Han, beyond Tonghua Gate and composed preface and verse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸安樂公主山亭，宴侍臣、學士，賜繒帛有差。

translations.literal: On yisi he visited Princess Anle's mountain pavilion, feasted scholar-officials, and granted silks in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he feasted scholars at Princess Anle's mountain pavilion and gave silks in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，幸九曲亭子，宴侍臣、學士。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renxu: he visited Nine-Bend Pavilion and feasted scholar-officials.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the ninth month he feasted scholars at Nine-Bend Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，吏部尚書、懷縣公蘇瑰為尚書右僕射、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On wuchen Minister of Personnel and Duke of Huai Su Gui was made Right Director of the Secretariat, co-equal with the Secretariat third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Su Gui, minister of personnel and Duke of Huai, became right director of the Secretariat with council standing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，幸安樂公主金城新宅，宴侍臣、學士。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, gengyin: he visited Princess Anle's new estate at Jincheng and feasted scholar-officials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the tenth winter month he banqueted scholars at Princess Anle's new Jincheng mansion.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，親祀南郊，皇后登壇亞獻，左僕射舒國公韋巨源為終獻。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yichou: he personally sacrificed at the southern suburb; the Empress ascended the altar for the second offering; Left Director and Duke of Shu Wei Juyuan made the final offering.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the eleventh month he sacrificed at the southern suburb; the empress made the second offering; Wei Juyuan, left director and Duke of Shu, the final one.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，見系囚徒及十惡咸赦除之，雜犯流人並放還。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; prisoners in custody and even the ten abominations were pardoned; miscellaneous offenders in exile were all sent home.
translations.idiomatic: He amnestied the realm, pardoning even those held for the ten capital crimes and returning miscellaneous exiles.

sentences.zh: 京文武三品已上賜爵一等，四品已下加一階，京官及應襲岳牧入三品五品減考，高年版授。

translations.literal: Capital officials of third rank and above received one noble rank; those of fourth rank and below one step; capital officials and those due to inherit frontier governorships of third and fifth rank had examinations reduced; the aged received patents by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials of third rank and above gained a noble rank, those below a step; heirs to frontier posts had examinations eased; the aged received honorary titles.

sentences.zh: 大酺三日。

translations.literal: Great revelry was granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of public revelry were granted.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸見子陵。

translations.literal: On renshen he visited Ziyu Ling's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he visited the tomb of Ziyu Ling.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，開府儀同三司、芮國公豆盧欽望薨。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Acting Third-Rank-in-the-Same-Office-as-the-Three-Dukes and Duke of Rui Dou Lu Qinwang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Dou Lu Qinwang, acting third grade and Duke of Rui, died.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃贊普遣其大臣尚贊吐來逆女。

translations.literal: The Tibetan king sent his minister Shangzan Tu to escort a bride in reverse direction.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan king sent minister Shangzan Tu to fetch a bride for the court.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，前尚書右僕射、宋國公唐休璟為太子少師、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renxu: former Right Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Song Tang Xiujing was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, co-equal with the Secretariat third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the twelfth month Tang Xiujing, former right director and Duke of Song, became junior tutor with council standing.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Emperor visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he went to the hot springs at Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸兵部尚書韋嗣立莊，封嗣立為逍遙公，上親制序賦詩，便游白鹿觀。

translations.literal: On gengzi he visited Minister of War Wei Sili's estate, enfeoffed Sili as Duke of Carefree Wandering, composed preface and poems himself, then toured White Deer Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he visited Wei Sili's villa, created him Duke of Carefree Wandering, wrote preface and verse himself, and wandered White Deer Abbey.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，曲賜新豐縣，百姓給復一年，行從官賜勛一轉。

translations.literal: On jiachen Xinfeng County was specially favored; the people were exempted from corvée for one year, and followers received one turn of merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Xinfeng was favored: its people were exempted from corvée for a year and those in the entourage gained one turn of merit.

sentences.zh: 是日幸驪山。

translations.literal: That day he visited Mount Li.
translations.idiomatic: That day he went to Mount Li.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On yisi he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he returned from the springs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，令諸司長官向醴泉坊看潑胡王乞寒戲。

translations.literal: On yiyou he ordered chief ministers of every office to go to Liquan Ward to watch the Pot-Hu King's cold-weather play.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he ordered every chief minister to Liquan Ward to watch the Pot-Hu King's cold-weather pageant.

sentences.zh: 景龍四年四年春正月乙卯，於化度寺門設無遮大齋。

translations.literal: Jinglong, fourth year, first month, spring, yimao: at the gate of Huadu Temple an unbounded great offering was set up.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the first spring month of the fourth year of Jinglong a great unbounded offering was held at Huadu Temple's gate.

sentences.zh: 丙寅上元夜，帝與皇后微行觀燈，因幸中書令蕭至忠之第。

translations.literal: On the Lantern Festival night the Emperor and Empress went in disguise to view the lamps, then visited Attendant-in-Chief Xiao Zhi Zhong's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On Lantern Festival night emperor and empress went out incognito to see the lamps and called at Xiao Zhi Zhong's house.

sentences.zh: 是夜，放宮女數千人看燈，因此多有亡逸者。

translations.literal: That night several thousand palace women were released to view the lamps, and many fled because of it.
translations.idiomatic: That night thousands of palace women were let out to see the lamps, and many used the chance to escape.

sentences.zh: 丁卯夜，又微行看燈。

translations.literal: On dingmao night he again went out incognito to view the lamps.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingmao he again stole out to see the lamps.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命左驍衛大將軍、河源軍使楊矩為送金城公主入吐蕃使。

translations.literal: On dingchou he appointed Left Valiant Cavalry Grand General and Protector of Heyuan Yang Ju as envoy escorting Princess Jincheng into Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Yang Ju, left valiant cavalry grand general and protector of Heyuan, was made envoy escorting Princess Jincheng to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸始平，送金城公主歸吐蕃。

translations.literal: On jimao he visited Shiping and sent Princess Jincheng home to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he went to Shiping and sent Princess Jincheng on to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，曲赦咸陽、始平，改始平為金城縣。

translations.literal: Second month, renwu: Xianyang and Shiping were specially pardoned; Shiping was renamed Jincheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the second month Xianyang and Shiping were specially pardoned and Shiping renamed Jincheng County.

sentences.zh: 便幸長安令王光輔馬嵬北原莊。

translations.literal: He then visited the estate of Chang'an magistrate Wang Guangfu on the north plain of Mawei.
translations.idiomatic: From there he visited the north-plain villa of Chang'an magistrate Wang Guangfu at Mawei.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至自金城。

translations.literal: On guiwei he returned from Jincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he came back from Jincheng.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，令中書門下供奉官五品已上、文武三品已上並諸學士等，自芳林門入，集於梨園球場，分朋拔河，帝與皇后、公主親往觀之。

translations.literal: On gengxu he ordered Secretariat attendants of fifth rank and above, civil and military officials of third rank and above, and all academicians to enter by the Fragrant Grove Gate, assemble at the Pear Garden ball ground, divide into teams for tug-of-war; the Emperor, Empress, and princesses went in person to watch.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he had fifth-rank Secretariat attendants, third-rank civil and military officers, and all academicians enter Fragrant Grove Gate to the Pear Garden grounds for tug-of-war; emperor, empress, and princesses watched in person.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，幸臨渭亭修禊飲，賜群官柳棬以闢惡。

translations.literal: Third month, jiayin: he visited Linwei Pavilion for the spring purification feast and granted officials willow wreaths to ward off evil.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the third month he held the spring purification at Linwei Pavilion and gave officials willow wreaths against ill luck.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，游宴桃花園。

translations.literal: On bingchen he toured and feasted at Peach Blossom Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he feasted at Peach Blossom Garden.

sentences.zh: 庚申，京師雨木冰，井溢。

translations.literal: On gengshen trees in the capital were glazed with ice; wells overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen ice sheathed the trees in the capital and wells brimmed over.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜宰臣已下內樣巾子。

translations.literal: On renxu he granted palace-style caps to chief ministers and below.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he gave palace-style caps to the chief ministers and those below.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，上游櫻桃園，引中書門下五品已上諸司長官學士等入芳林園嘗櫻桃，便令馬上口摘，置酒為樂。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dinghai: the Emperor toured Cherry Orchard, led Secretariat officials of fifth rank and above, chiefs of offices, and academicians into Fragrant Grove Garden to taste cherries, ordered them to pick from horseback, and set out wine for pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the fourth summer month he toured Cherry Orchard, brought fifth-rank Secretariat men, department heads, and scholars into Fragrant Grove to taste cherries from horseback, and made a revel of it.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸隆慶池，結彩為樓，宴侍臣，泛舟戲樂，因幸禮部尚書竇希宅。

translations.literal: On yiwei he visited Longqing Pond, built a pavilion of colored silks, feasted close ministers, sported in boats, then visited Minister of Rites Dou Xi's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he went to Longqing Pond, hung a pavilion in colored silk, banqueted intimates, sported in boats, then called at Dou Xi's house.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，秘書監、賜虢王邕改封汴王。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinyou: Director of the Palace Library and Prince of Guo Yong was re-enfeoffed Prince of Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the fifth month Yong, director of the palace library and Prince of Guo, was re-enfeoffed Prince of Bian.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇后請加嗣王三品。

translations.literal: On yichou the Empress requested that collateral princes be raised to third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the empress asked that collateral princes be raised to third rank.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，前許州司兵參軍燕欽融上書，言皇后干預國政，安樂公主、武延秀、宗楚客等同危宗社。

translations.literal: On dingmao former Xuzhou military adjutant Yan Qinrong submitted a memorial saying the Empress interfered in state affairs, and Princess Anle, Wu Yanxiu, and Zong Chuke alike endangered the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Yan Qinrong, former Xuzhou adjutant, memorialized that the empress meddled in rule and Princess Anle, Wu Yanxiu, and Zong Chuke together threatened the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，召欽融廷見，撲殺之。

translations.literal: The Emperor in anger summoned Qinrong to court audience and had him beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in fury summoned Qinrong and had him beaten to death in the hall.

sentences.zh: 時安樂公主志欲皇后臨朝稱制，而求立為皇太女，自是與后合謀進鴆。

translations.literal: At that time Princess Anle wished the Empress to hold court and rule in her own name, and sought to be made heir apparent as "Grand Imperial Daughter"; from this she joined the Empress in plotting to advance poison.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Anle then wanted the empress to rule openly and herself named heir as "Grand Imperial Daughter"; with the empress she plotted poison.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，帝遇毒，崩於神龍殿，年五十五。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renwu: the Emperor met poison and died in the Divine Dragon Hall, aged fifty-five.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the sixth month the emperor took poison and died in the Divine Dragon Hall, aged fifty-five.

sentences.zh: 秘不發喪，皇后親總庶政。

translations.literal: Death was kept secret; the Empress personally directed all government.
translations.idiomatic: The death was concealed while the empress seized every lever of government.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以刑部尚書裴談、工部尚書張錫並同中書門下三品，依舊東都留守。

translations.literal: On guiwei Minister of Punishments Pei Tan and Minister of Works Zhang Xi were made co-equal with the Secretariat third grade, remaining as before at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Pei Tan, minister of punishments, and Zhang Xi, minister of works, entered the council as third grade, still stationed at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書張喜福、中書侍郎岑羲、吏部侍郎崔湜並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Zhang Xifu, Vice Director of the Secretariat Cen Yi, and Vice Director of Personnel Cui Shi were made co-equal with the Secretariat as Rectifiers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xifu, Cen Yi, and Cui Shi joined the council as rectifiers.

sentences.zh: 又命左右金吾衛大將軍趙承恩、右監門大將軍薛簡帥兵五百人往均州，備譙王重福。

translations.literal: He also ordered Left Golden Guard Grand General Zhao Chengen and Right Gate Guard Grand General Xue Jian to lead five hundred troops to Junzhou to guard against Prince of Qiao Chongfu.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Zhao Chengen and Xue Jian with five hundred guards to Junzhou against Prince of Qiao Chongfu.

sentences.zh: 立溫王重茂為皇太子。

translations.literal: Prince of Wen Chongmao was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wen Chongmao was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 甲申，發喪於太極殿，宣遺制。

translations.literal: On jiashen mourning was proclaimed in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and the testamentary edict was announced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen mourning was opened in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and the testament read aloud.

sentences.zh: 皇太后臨朝，大赦天下，改元為唐隆。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager held court; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Tanglong.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager ruled from court, amnestied the realm, and renamed the era Tanglong.

sentences.zh: 見系囚徒常赦所不免者咸赦除之，長流任放歸田里，負犯痕瘕咸從洗滌。

translations.literal: Prisoners in custody whom regular amnesties never spared were all pardoned; long exiles might return to their villages; marks of crime and punishment were washed clean.
translations.idiomatic: Even prisoners regular amnesties never touched were freed; long exiles could go home; criminal marks were erased.

sentences.zh: 內外官三品已上賜爵一級，四品已下加一階。

translations.literal: Officials within and without of third rank and above received one noble rank; those of fourth rank and below one step.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of third rank and above gained a noble rank, those of fourth rank and below a step.

sentences.zh: 以安國相王旦為太子太師。

translations.literal: The Prince of An'guo Li Dan was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dan, Prince of An'guo, was made grand tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 進封雍王守禮為邠王，壽春郡王成器為宋王，宗正卿晉封新興王。

translations.literal: Prince of Yong Shouli was advanced to Prince of Bin; Prince of Shouchun Chengi to Prince of Song; Director of the Imperial Clan Jin to Prince of Xing.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli became Prince of Bin; Chengi, Prince of Song; Jin, director of the imperial clan, Prince of Xing.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，皇太子即帝位於柩前，時年十六。

translations.literal: On dinghai the crown prince assumed the throne before the coffin, aged sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the crown prince took the throne before the coffin, aged sixteen.

sentences.zh: 皇太后韋氏臨朝稱制，大赦天下，常赦所不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Wei held court and ruled in her own name; a general amnesty was proclaimed; even those regular amnesties never spared were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wei ruled in her own name, amnestied the realm, and pardoned even those whom ordinary amnesties excluded.

sentences.zh: 內外兵馬諸親掌，仍令韋溫總知。

translations.literal: All military affairs within and without and among the imperial kin remained under Wei Wen's overall command.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Wen kept overall command of armies within and without and among the imperial kin.

sentences.zh: 時召諸府折沖兵五萬人分屯京城，列為左右營，諸韋子侄分統之。

translations.literal: At the time fifty thousand frontier soldiers were summoned and stationed in the capital in left and right camps; Wei nephews and sons-in-law each commanded them.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand frontier troops were called in and split into left and right camps around the capital, each camp under a Wei nephew or son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使諸道巡撫，紀處訥關內道，張嘉福河北道，岑羲河南道。

translations.literal: On renchen envoys were sent to inspect the circuits: Ji Chuna for Guannei, Zhang Jiafu for Hebei, Cen Yi for Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen inspection envoys were sent: Ji Chuna to Guannei, Zhang Jiafu to Hebei, Cen Yi to Henan.

sentences.zh: 庚子夜，臨淄王諱舉兵誅諸韋、武，皆梟首於安福門外，韋太后為亂兵所殺。

translations.literal: On gengzi night the Prince of Linzi raised troops, executed the Wei and Wu clans; all were exposed at the head outside Peace and Blessing Gate; Empress Dowager Wei was killed by the mutinous troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengzi Li Longji, Prince of Linzi, rose and slaughtered the Wei and Wu factions; their heads hung outside Peace and Blessing Gate, and Empress Wei died at the soldiers' hands.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，百官上謚曰孝和皇帝，廟號中宗。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingmao: the hundred officials proposed the posthumous title Emperor Xiaohé and temple name Zhongzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingmao, the court gave the posthumous title Emperor Xiaohé and temple name Zhongzong.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，葬於定陵。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiyou: he was buried at Ding Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the eleventh month he was buried at Ding Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載二月，改謚曰大和大聖大昭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Second month of the thirteenth year of Tianbao, the posthumous title was changed to Emperor Dahe Dasheng Dazhao Xiaohé.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tianbao 13 his posthumous title was raised to Emperor Dahe Dasheng Dazhao Xiaohé.

sentences.zh: 【史評】史臣曰：廉士可以律貪夫，賢臣不能輔孱主。

translations.literal: 【Historian's appraisal】 The historian says: An upright man can restrain a greedy one by law; a worthy minister cannot support a feeble sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: 【Historian's appraisal】 The historian says: Law in the hands of the upright can bind the greedy, but no worthy minister can shore up a weak throne.

sentences.zh: 誠以志昏近習，心無遠圖，不知創業之難，唯取當年之樂。

translations.literal: Truly, when the will is dimmed by those near at hand and the heart holds no far design, one does not know the hardship of founding, but only grasps the pleasures of the moment.
translations.idiomatic: When the will is dulled by favorites and the heart has no distant design, the hardship of founding is forgotten and only the day's pleasures are seized.

sentences.zh: 孝和皇帝越自負扆，遷於房陵，崎嶇瘴癘之鄉，契闊幽囚之地。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaohé, from taking the throne at the royal screen to removal to Fangling, in rugged lands of miasma and plague, in the trials of close imprisonment—
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaohé, from the throne to exile at Fangling, knew rugged miasma country and the bitterness of close imprisonment—

sentences.zh: 所以張漢陽徘徊於克復，狄梁公哽咽以奏論，遂得生還，庸非己力。

translations.literal: therefore Zhang Hanyang hesitated at restoration, Di Liang Gong wept as he presented his memorial, and he was able to return alive—not by his own strength alone.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hanyang then wavered at restoration, Di Renjie pleaded through tears, and the emperor lived to return—hardly by his own power alone.

sentences.zh: 洎滌除金虎，再握璇衡，不能罪己以謝萬方，而更漫游以隳八政。

translations.literal: When the golden tiger was washed away and he again grasped the jade axis, he could not blame himself before the ten thousand directions, but wandered further and ruined the eight policies.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wu usurpation ended and he again held the jade scepter, he would not confess fault to the realm but roamed on, wrecking the eight great duties of rule.

sentences.zh: 縱艷妻之煽黨，則棸、楀爭衡；

translations.literal: He indulged a lustful wife's faction, and then Zhu and Yu contended for power;
translations.idiomatic: He let a wanton consort fan her faction until Zhu and Yu wrestled for the scale;

sentences.zh: 信妖女以撓權，則彞倫失序。

translations.literal: he trusted a sorcerous woman to twist authority, and then the human relations lost their order.
translations.idiomatic: he trusted a witch-woman to bend the law until human order itself broke.

sentences.zh: 桓、敬由之覆族，節愍所以興戈，竟以元首之尊，不免齊眉之禍。

translations.literal: Huan and Jing were ruined by this; Jiemin therefore raised arms—yet in the end, though he held the sovereign's person, he could not escape the calamity of bowed brows.
translations.idiomatic: Huan and Jing fell to it; Jiemin took up arms—yet though he wore the crown he could not escape death at his consort's hands.

sentences.zh: 比漢、晉之惠、盈輩為優，茍非繼以命世之才，則土德去也。

translations.literal: Compared with the Hui and Ying of Han and Jin he was the better man, yet unless a world-ordering talent followed, the virtue of earth would depart.
translations.idiomatic: Beside the Hui and Ying of Han and Jin he shines, yet without a world-ordering heir the Mandate of earth would have slipped away.

sentences.zh: 睿宗睿宗玄真大聖大興孝皇帝，諱旦，高宗第八子，中宗母弟。

translations.literal: Ruizong Emperor Ruizong the Mysterious True Great Sage Great Prosperous Filial, taboo name Dan, was the eighth son of Gaozong and the younger brother of Zhongzong by the same mother.
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong, the Mysterious True Great Sage Great Prosperous Filial Emperor, taboo name Dan, was Gaozong's eighth son and Zhongzong's younger brother by the same mother.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年六月己未，生於長安。

translations.literal: Longshuo, second year, sixth month, jiwei: he was born in Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Longshuo, on jiwei, he was born in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 其年封殷王，遙領冀州大都督、單于大都護、右金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: That year he was enfeoffed Prince of Yin, holding from afar the governorship-general of Ji and the qaghanate of the Shanyu, and Grand General of the Right Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was made Prince of Yin, titular governor-general of Ji and qaghan of the Shanyu, and right golden guard grand general.

sentences.zh: 及長，謙恭孝友，好學，工草隸，尤愛文字訓詁之書。

translations.literal: When grown he was modest, respectful, filial, and friendly, fond of learning, skilled in draft cursive script, and especially loved books on characters and glosses.
translations.idiomatic: As he grew he was modest, filial, and fond of learning, skilled in cursive script and especially devoted to philology.

sentences.zh: 乾封元年，徙封豫王。

translations.literal: First year of Qianfeng: he was transferred to Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianfeng he was transferred to Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 總章二年，徙封冀王。

translations.literal: Second year of Zongzhang: he was transferred to Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zongzhang he was made Prince of Ji.

sentences.zh: 上初名旭輪，至是去「旭」字。

translations.literal: At first his name was Xulun; at this time the character Xu was removed.
translations.idiomatic: He had first been named Xulun; now the character Xu was dropped.

sentences.zh: 上元二年，徙封相王，拜右衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Second year of Shangyuan: he was transferred to Prince of Xiang and appointed Grand General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shangyuan he became Prince of Xiang and right guard grand general.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳三年，遷洛牧；

translations.literal: Third year of Yifeng: he was made Governor of Luo;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yifeng he was made governor of Luo;

sentences.zh: 改名旦，徙封豫王。

translations.literal: his name was changed to Dan and he was transferred to Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: renamed Dan, and transferred to Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 嗣聖元年，則天臨朝，廢中宗為廬陵王，立豫王為皇帝，仍臨朝稱制。

translations.literal: First year of Sisheng: Wu Zetian held court; Zhongzong was deposed to Prince of Luling and Yu Wang was installed as emperor, while she still ruled in her own name.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Sisheng Wu Zetian ruled from court, deposed Zhongzong to Prince of Luling, and set Yu Wang on the throne while she still held power.

sentences.zh: 及革命，改國號為周，降帝為皇嗣，令依舊名輪，徙居東宮，其具儀一比皇太子。

translations.literal: When she changed the dynasty, the state name became Zhou; the Emperor was reduced to Imperial Heir and ordered to use his former name Lun, moved to the eastern palace, his rites matching the crown prince's.
translations.idiomatic: When she declared Zhou, the emperor became imperial heir, took back the name Lun, moved to the eastern palace, and was treated as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 聖歷元年，中宗自房陵還。

translations.literal: First year of Shenglí: Zhongzong returned from Fangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shenglí Zhongzong returned from Fangling.

sentences.zh: 帝數稱疾不朝，請讓位於中宗。

translations.literal: The Emperor repeatedly claimed illness and did not attend court, asking to yield the throne to Zhongzong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dan repeatedly pleaded illness, stayed from court, and asked to yield to Zhongzong.

sentences.zh: 則天遂立中宗為皇太子，封帝為相王，又改名旦，授太子右衛率。

translations.literal: Wu Zetian then installed Zhongzong as crown prince, enfeoffed the Emperor as Prince of Xiang, again changed his name to Dan, and appointed him Right Commander of the Crown Prince's Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zetian made Zhongzong crown prince, created Li Dan Prince of Xiang, renamed him Dan, and made him right commander of the crown prince's guard.

sentences.zh: 長安中，拜司徒、右羽林衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In the Chang'an era he was appointed Grand Tutor and Grand General of the Right Yulin Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chang'an years he became grand tutor and right Yulin grand general.

sentences.zh: 自則天初臨朝及革命之際，王室屢有變故，帝每恭儉退讓，竟免於禍。

translations.literal: From Wu Zetian's first holding of court through the change of dynasty, the royal house suffered repeated upheavals; the Emperor each time was respectful, frugal, and yielding, and in the end escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: Through Wu Zetian's rise and the Zhou revolution the house of Li shook again and again; each time Li Dan bowed, yielded, and in the end survived.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年，以誅張易之昆弟功，進號安國相王，遷太尉，加實封。

translations.literal: First year of Shenlong: for the merit of executing Zhang Yizhi and his brothers he was advanced to Prince of An'guo, made Grand Marshal, and given added fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shenlong, for killing Zhang Yizhi and his brothers, he was advanced to Prince of An'guo, made grand marshal, and given added fief.

sentences.zh: 其年立為皇太弟，固辭不受。

translations.literal: That year he was installed as Imperial Younger Brother; he firmly declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was offered the title imperial younger brother and firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 景雲元年景龍四年夏六月，中宗崩，韋庶人臨朝，引用其黨，分握政柄，忌帝望實素高，潛謀危害。

translations.literal: First year of Jingyun, summer, sixth month of Jinglong's fourth year: Zhongzong died; Empress Wei held court, brought in her faction, divided grasp of power, and because the Emperor's repute had long been high, secretly plotted harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Jinglong 4, in the first year of Jingyun, Zhongzong died; Empress Wei ruled, packed office with her kin, and, fearing Li Dan's standing, plotted against him in secret.

sentences.zh: 庚子夜，臨淄王諱與太平公主子薛崇簡、前朝邑尉劉幽求、長上果毅麻嗣宗、苑總監鐘紹京等率兵入北軍，誅韋溫、紀處訥、宗楚客、武延秀、馬秦客、葉靜能、趙履溫、楊均等，諸韋、武黨與皆誅之。

translations.literal: On gengzi night Li Longji, with Xue Chongjian son of Princess Taiping, former Chaoyi county magistrate Liu Youqiu, long-serving guard Ma Sizong, park director Zhong Shaojing, and others led troops into the Northern Army, executed Wei Wen, Ji Chuna, Zong Chuke, Wu Yanxiu, Ma Qinke, Ye Jingneng, Zhao Lüwen, Yang Jun, and the rest; all Wei and Wu partisans were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengzi Li Longji, with Xue Chongjian, Liu Youqiu, Ma Sizong, Zhong Shaojing, and others, stormed the Northern Army, killed Wei Wen, Ji Chuna, Zong Chuke, Wu Yanxiu, and the rest, and wiped out the Wei and Wu factions.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，帝挾少帝御安福門樓慰諭百姓，大赦天下，見系囚徒常赦所不免者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Emperor, supporting the young emperor, mounted Peace and Blessing Gate tower to reassure the people; a general amnesty was proclaimed; prisoners whom regular amnesties never spared were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Dan, supporting the boy on the throne, mounted Peace and Blessing Gate to calm the people and amnestied even those whom ordinary amnesties excluded.

sentences.zh: 內外文武官三品已上賜爵一級，四品已下加一階，親皇三等已上加兩階，四等已下及諸親賜勛三轉，天下百姓免今年田租之半。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without of third rank and above received one noble rank; those of fourth rank and below one step; imperial kin of third rank and above two steps, of fourth rank and below and other kin three turns of merit; the people's land tax for the year was halved.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officials and above gained a noble rank, those below a step; close kin of third rank and above two steps; other kin three turns of merit; the year's land tax was halved for the people.

sentences.zh: 進封臨淄王為平王，以薛崇簡為立節郡王。

translations.literal: The Prince of Linzi was advanced to Prince of Ping; Xue Chongjian was made Prince of Lijie.
translations.idiomatic: Li Longji became Prince of Ping; Xue Chongjian was made Prince of Lijie.

sentences.zh: 鐘紹京為中書侍郎，劉幽求為中書舍人，並參知機務，加實封。

translations.literal: Zhong Shaojing was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Liu Youqiu Secretariat Drafting Officer; both shared in secrets of state and received added fief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Shaojing became vice director of the Secretariat; Liu Youqiu, drafting officer; both entered the inner council and gained added fief.

sentences.zh: 其餘封賞有差。

translations.literal: The rest received enfeoffment and reward in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: Others were enfeoffed and rewarded in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 遣使分行諸道宣諭，仍令往均州慰勞譙王。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent on separate routes to proclaim the news, still ordered to go to Junzhou to comfort Prince of Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys carried the proclamation on every road and were still sent to Junzhou to comfort Prince of Qiao.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，左千牛中郎將、宋王成器為左衛大將軍，司農少卿同正員、衡陽王成義為右衛大將軍，太府少卿同正員、巴陵王隆範為左羽林衛大將軍，太僕少卿同正員、彭城王隆業為右羽林衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On renyin Left Thousand-Oxen Captain Prince of Song Chengi was made Left Guard Grand General; Assistant Director of Agriculture with concurrent regular appointment Prince of Hengyang Chengyi Right Guard Grand General; Assistant Director of the Grand Treasury with concurrent regular appointment Prince of Baling Longfan Left Yulin Grand General; Assistant Director of the Imperial Stud with concurrent regular appointment Prince of Pengcheng Longye Right Yulin Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Chengi became left guard grand general; Chengyi, right guard; Longfan, left Yulin; Longye, right Yulin.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎李日知同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Yellow Gate Li Rizhi was made co-equal with the Secretariat third grade.
translations.idiomatic: Li Rizhi, vice director of the Yellow Gate, entered the council as third grade.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，殿中兼知內外閑廄、檢校龍武右軍、仍押左右廂萬騎平王諱同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On guimao Prince of Ping, palace attendant in charge of inner and outer stud farms, inspecting general of the Right Dragon Martial Army, and still commanding the left and right Ten Thousand Horse wings, was made co-equal with the Secretariat third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li Longji, Prince of Ping, with stud, dragon martial, and Ten Thousand Horse commands, joined the council as third grade.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎、潁川郡公鐘紹京為中書令。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Yingchuan Zhong Shaojing was made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Shaojing, vice director and Duke of Yingchuan, became director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 中書令、酂國公蕭至忠為許州刺史，兵部尚書、逍遙公韋嗣立為宋州刺史，中書侍郎趙彥昭為絳州刺史，蕭、韋、趙特置位。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Zan Xiao Zhi Zhong was made Prefect of Xuzhou; Minister of War and Duke of Carefree Wandering Wei Sili Prefect of Songzhou; Vice Director of the Secretariat Zhao Yanzhao Prefect of Jiangzhou—Xiao, Wei, and Zhao were specially placed.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zhi Zhong was sent to Xuzhou, Wei Sili to Songzhou, Zhao Yanzhao to Jiangzhou—posts made for them alone.

sentences.zh: 誅吏部尚書張嘉福於懷州。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Zhang Jiafu was executed at Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiafu, minister of personnel, was executed at Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 其日，王公百僚上表，咸以國家多難，宜立長君，以帝眾望所歸，請即尊位。

translations.literal: That day the dukes and hundred officials memorialized together: the state faced many calamities and should install a mature sovereign; because the Emperor was where all eyes turned, they asked that he immediately take the supreme seat.
translations.idiomatic: That day the nobles and officials memorialized: the realm was in peril and needed a seasoned ruler; all eyes were on Li Dan, and they begged him to mount the throne at once.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，少帝詔曰：「自古帝王，必有符命，兄弟相及，存諸典禮。

translations.literal: On jiachen the young emperor's edict said: "From antiquity emperors and kings have had their mandates; brothers succeeding one another is preserved in the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the boy emperor's edict ran: "Since antiquity rulers have borne a mandate; brother succeeding brother stands in the rites.

sentences.zh: 朕以孤藐，遭家艱難，顧茲蒙識，未洽治途。

translations.literal: I, being young and small, have met family hardship; facing this burden my understanding does not reach the way of rule.
translations.idiomatic: I am young and small and have met a house in grief; set on this seat I do not yet know how to govern.

sentences.zh: 茫茫四海，將何所屬，累聖丕基，若墜於地。

translations.literal: The four seas stretch vast—whom shall they belong to? The piled blessing of many sages seems about to fall to earth.
translations.idiomatic: The four seas are vast—whom shall they obey? The piled blessing of many sages seems ready to fall.

sentences.zh: 王室多難，義擇長君，思與群公，推崇明聖。

translations.literal: The royal house has many woes; righteousness chooses the elder lord. I wish with you lords to exalt a bright sage.
translations.idiomatic: The house of Li is in peril; righteousness demands the elder. I wish with you, lords, to raise a bright sage.

sentences.zh: 叔父相王，高宗之子，昔以天下，讓於先帝，孝友寬簡，彰信兆人。

translations.literal: My uncle the Prince of Xiang, son of Gaozong, once yielded the realm to the former emperor; filial, friendly, broad, and simple, his faith shines on the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: My uncle the Prince of Xiang, Gaozong's son, once yielded the realm to my father; filial, gentle, and trusted by the people.

sentences.zh: 神龍之初，己有明旨，將立太弟，以為副君。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shenlong there was already a clear decree to install the imperial younger brother as deputy ruler.
translations.idiomatic: At Shenlong's beginning a clear decree already named him imperial younger brother and deputy ruler.

sentences.zh: 為王懇辭，未行冊命，所以東宮虛位，至於歷年。

translations.literal: The Prince of Wang firmly declined and the investiture was not carried out, so the eastern palace stood empty for years.
translations.idiomatic: He firmly declined and the seal was never given, so the eastern palace stood empty for years.

sentences.zh: 徹綴在辰，禍變倉卒，後掖稱制，計立沖人。

translations.literal: The imperial robe hung in the hour of chen; calamity changed in sudden haste; the rear palace ruled in her own name and plotted to set a child on the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The robe was torn in the hour of chen; disaster struck in haste; the rear palace ruled and meant to set a child on the throne.

sentences.zh: 欽奉前懷，願遵理命。

translations.literal: Reverently holding the former wish, I wish to follow reason's command.
translations.idiomatic: Holding to the former wish, I mean to follow reason's command.

sentences.zh: 上申天聖之旨，下遂蒼生之心；

translations.literal: Above to declare Heaven and the sages' intent; below to settle the heart of the black-haired people;
translations.idiomatic: Above to declare Heaven's will and the sages' intent; below to settle the people's hearts;

sentences.zh: 俯稽圖緯之文，仰跂祖宗之烈。

translations.literal: bowing to the charts and apocrypha, looking up to the ancestors' glory.
translations.idiomatic: I bow to the charts and apocrypha and look up to the glory of the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 擇今日，請叔父相王即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Choosing this day, I ask my uncle the Prince of Xiang to assume the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: On this day I ask my uncle the Prince of Xiang to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 朕退守本籓，歸於舊邸。

translations.literal: I withdraw to guard my original fief and return to my old residence.
translations.idiomatic: I withdraw to my fief and return to my old residence.

sentences.zh: 凡百卿士，敬承朕言，克贊我天人之休期，光我有唐之勛業。

translations.literal: All you ministers, respect my words, help fulfill this heaven-and-man season of rest, and brighten our Tang's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: All you ministers, heed my words, help fulfill this season of heaven and man, and brighten the achievement of Tang.

sentences.zh: 布告遐邇，咸使聞知。

translations.literal: Proclaim far and near and let all hear and know."
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed far and near."

sentences.zh: 」相王上表，讓曰：「臣以宗社事重，家國情深，誅鋤巨逆，奉戴嗣主。

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiang submitted a memorial declining, saying: "The altars' affair is weighty, the house and state are deep in my heart; I executed great rebels and supported the successor lord.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dan memorialized his refusal: "The altars weigh heavy on my heart; I slew great rebels and upheld the successor.

sentences.zh: 今承制旨，猥推宸極。

translations.literal: Now I receive the imperial command and am rashly pushed to the imperial pinnacle.
translations.idiomatic: Now I receive the command and am rashly pushed to the pinnacle.

sentences.zh: 在臣虛薄，不敢祗膺。

translations.literal: In my emptiness and shallowness I dare not reverently accept.
translations.idiomatic: I am empty and shallow and dare not accept with reverence.

sentences.zh: 循環震驚，無任感哽！

translations.literal: Turning in shock and trembling, I cannot bear the grief and choke!"
translations.idiomatic: Turning in shock and trembling, I cannot bear the grief!"

sentences.zh: 」制答曰：「皇極大寶，天下至公，王者臨之，蓋非獲已。

translations.literal: The edict answered: "The great treasure of the imperial pole is the utmost public good under heaven; for a king to face it is mostly not by his own wish.
translations.idiomatic: The reply edict said: "The great treasure of the pole is the utmost public good under heaven; a king takes it mostly not by his own wish.

sentences.zh: 王先聖舊意，蒼生推仰，龍光紫宸，貴允系望。

translations.literal: You, Prince, have the former sage's old intent; the black-haired people look up to you; dragon light at the purple court should fulfill the succession's hope.
translations.idiomatic: You, prince, hold the former sage's intent; the people look up to you; let dragon light at the purple court fulfill what all await.

sentences.zh: 請遵前旨，勿或推讓。

translations.literal: Please follow the former command and do not again decline."
translations.idiomatic: Follow the former command and do not decline again."

sentences.zh: 」於是少帝遜於別宮。

translations.literal: Thereupon the young emperor withdrew to a separate palace.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the boy emperor withdrew to a separate palace.

sentences.zh: 是日即皇帝位，御承天門樓，大赦天下，常赦所不免並原之。

translations.literal: That day he at once took the imperial throne, attended from Chengtian Gate tower, and proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven; those not normally exempted in regular amnesties were all likewise pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he took the throne, appeared on Chengtian Gate tower, and proclaimed a general amnesty; even crimes ordinary amnesties would not touch were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 內外官四品已上加一階，相王府官吏加兩階。

translations.literal: Inner and outer officials of fourth rank and above received one rank promotion; Xiangwang Mansion clerks received two.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officers of fourth rank and above were promoted one step; staff of the Prince of Xiang’s household, two.

sentences.zh: 流人長流、長任未還者並放還。

translations.literal: Exiles on perpetual banishment or perpetual penal service not yet returned were all released to go home.
translations.idiomatic: Those still abroad on lifelong exile or lifelong penal service were all sent home.

sentences.zh: 立功人王承曄已下千餘人，賜爵秩有差。

translations.literal: More than a thousand men who had won merit, from Wang Chengye downward, were granted titles and ranks in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Over a thousand merit-holders from Wang Chengye down received enfeoffments and offices according to their deeds.

sentences.zh: 封少帝為溫王。

translations.literal: The Young Emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Wen.
translations.idiomatic: The deposed emperor was made Prince of Wen.

sentences.zh: 其日，景雲見。

translations.literal: That day, auspicious clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: That day the sky showed auspicious clouds.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，中書令鐘紹京為戶部尚書、越國公，實封五百戶；

translations.literal: On yisi, Grand Counselor Zhong Shaojing was made Minister of Revenue and Duke of Yue, with a substantive fief of five hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Zhong Shaojing, Grand Counselor, became Minister of Revenue and Duke of Yue with five hundred household fiefs;

sentences.zh: 中書舍人劉幽求為尚書左丞、徐國公，實封五百戶：並依前知政事。

translations.literal: Palace Draftsman Liu Youqiu was made Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs and Duke of Xu, with a substantive fief of five hundred households: both continued as before in managing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Draftsman Liu Youqiu became Left Assistant Director and Duke of Xu with five hundred households: both men kept their roles in governance.

sentences.zh: 左衛大將軍、宋王成器為太子太師、雍州牧、揚州大都督，加實封二百戶。

translations.literal: General of the Left Guards, Prince of Song Chengqi, was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Governor of Yongzhou, and Grand Commander of Yangzhou, with an added substantive fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Chengqi, Prince of Song and General of the Left Guards, was named Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Yongzhou governor, and Yangzhou commander, with two hundred added fief households.

sentences.zh: 宮人比來取百姓子女入宮者，放還其家。

translations.literal: Palace women who had lately taken commoners’ sons and daughters into the palace were sent back to their families.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners’ children recently seized for the palace were returned home.

sentences.zh: 丙午，新除太常少卿薛稷為黃門侍郎，參知機務。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the newly appointed Vice Minister of Rites Xue Ji was made Attendant of the Yellow Gate and joined in managing critical affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Xue Ji, fresh from Vice Minister of Rites, entered the Yellow Gate and the inner council.

sentences.zh: 丁未，許州刺史、梁縣侯姚元之為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品，兵部尚書韋嗣立為中書令。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Xu Prefecture governor and Marquis of Liangxian Yao Yuanzhi was made Minister of War and Grand Counselor of the third rank; Minister of War Wei Sili was made Grand Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yao Yuanzhi of Xu became Minister of War and third-rank counselor; Wei Sili moved from that ministry to Grand Counselor.

sentences.zh: 追削武三思、武崇訓官爵。

translations.literal: The titles and ranks of Wu Sansi and Wu Chongxun were posthumously stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sansi and Wu Chongxun were posthumously disgraced and their ranks revoked.

sentences.zh: 戊申，蕭至忠、韋嗣立、趙彥昭、崔湜並停刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xiao Zhizhong, Wei Sili, Zhao Yanzhao, and Cui Shi were all removed from prefectural posts.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xiao Zhizhong, Wei Sili, Zhao Yanzhao, and Cui Shi left their governorships.

sentences.zh: 衡陽王成義封申王，巴陵王降範封岐王，彭城王隆業封薛王。

translations.literal: Prince of Hengyang Chengyi was enfeoffed as Prince of Shen; Prince of Baling Jiangfan as Prince of Qi; Prince of Pengcheng Longye as Prince of Xue.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyi became Prince of Shen, Jiangfan Prince of Qi, and Longye Prince of Xue.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鎮國太平公主加實封五百戶，通前一萬戶。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the Princess of Zhenguo Taiping received an added substantive fief of five hundred households, ten thousand in all with prior grants.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Princess Taiping of Zhenguo gained five hundred more fief households, ten thousand in total.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，兵部侍郎兼知雍州長史崔日用為黃門侍郎，參知機務。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou, Vice Minister of War and acting Yongzhou chief administrator Cui Riyong was made Attendant of the Yellow Gate and joined in managing critical affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the seventh month Cui Riyong, Vice Minister of War and acting Yongzhou chief, entered the Yellow Gate and the inner council.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，則天大聖皇后依舊號為天后。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Empress Zetian the Great Sage was restored to her former title of Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wu Zetian was again styled Empress.

sentences.zh: 追謚雍王賢為章懷太子，庶人重俊曰節愍太子。

translations.literal: Prince of Yong Xian was posthumously titled Crown Prince Zhanghuai; the commoner Chongjun was styled Crown Prince Jiemin.
translations.idiomatic: The deposed Prince of Yong Xian was posthumously named Crown Prince Zhanghuai; Chongjun, Crown Prince Jiemin.

sentences.zh: 復敬暉、桓彥範、崔玄暐、張柬之、袁恕己、成王千里、李多祚等官爵。

translations.literal: The offices and ranks of Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, Cui Xuanwei, Zhang Jianzhi, Yuan Shuoji, Prince of Cheng Qianli, Li Duozuo, and others were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, Cui Xuanwei, Zhang Jianzhi, Yuan Shuoji, Prince of Cheng Qianli, Li Duozuo, and the rest had rank and title restored.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，河南、洛陽、華州並依舊名。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Henan, Luoyang, and Hua prefectures all resumed their former names.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Henan, Luoyang, and Hua prefectures took back their old names.

sentences.zh: 以洛州長史宋璟為檢校吏部尚書、同中書門下三品，中書侍郎岑羲為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Luozhou chief administrator Song Jing was made acting Minister of Personnel and Grand Counselor of the third rank; Palace Draftsman Cen Xi was made Right Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jing of Luozhou became acting Personnel minister and third-rank counselor; Cen Xi, Right Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以蕭至忠為晉州刺史，韋嗣立為許州刺史，趙彥昭為宋州刺史，兵部尚書姚元之兼太子右庶子，吏部尚書宋璟兼太子左庶子。

translations.literal: On renxu, Xiao Zhizhong was made Jinzhou governor, Wei Sili Xuzhou governor, Zhao Yanzhao Songzhou governor; Minister of War Yao Yuanzhi also served as Right Subprefect of the Heir Apparent; Minister of Personnel Song Jing also served as Left Subprefect of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xiao Zhizhong went to Jinzhou, Wei Sili to Xuzhou, Zhao Yanzhao to Songzhou; Yao Yuanzhi doubled as Right Heir Apparent subprefect and Song Jing as Left.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，吏部侍郎崔湜為尚書右丞，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On guihai, Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Shi was made Right Assistant Director and removed from managing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Cui Shi became Right Assistant Director and left the inner council.

sentences.zh: 甲子，右僕射許國公蘇瑰、兵部尚書姚元之、吏部尚書宋璟、右常侍判刑部尚書岑羲並充使冊定陵。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Right Vice Director Su Gui of Xu, Minister of War Yao Yuanzhi, Minister of Personnel Song Jing, and Right Regular Attendant acting as Minister of Justice Cen Xi were all commissioned to fix the regnal title of Dingling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Su Gui, Yao Yuanzhi, Song Jing, and Cen Xi (acting Justice minister) were sent to set the posthumous style for Dingling.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，姚元之兼中書令。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Yao Yuanzhi also served as Grand Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yao Yuanzhi added the Grand Counselor title.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，蘇瑰為尚書左僕射，仍舊同中書同下三品。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Su Gui was made Left Vice Director, still Grand Counselor of the third rank as before.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Su Gui became Left Vice Director while keeping third-rank Grand Counselor status.

sentences.zh: 宋國公唐休璟致仕。

translations.literal: Tang Xiujing, Duke of Song, retired.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Xiujing, Duke of Song, left office.

sentences.zh: 右武衛大將軍、攝右御史大夫、同中書門下三品、韓國公張仁亶右衛大將軍。

translations.literal: General of the Right Martial Guards, acting Right Censor-in-Chief, Grand Counselor of the third rank, Zhang Renbian, Duke of Han, was made General of the Right Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Renbian, Duke of Han, moved from Right Martial Guards and acting Right Censor-in-Chief to General of the Right Guards.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，崔日用為雍州長史，薛稷為右散騎常侍，並停知機務。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Cui Riyong was made Yongzhou chief administrator and Xue Ji Right Regular Attendant; both ceased managing critical affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Cui Riyong took Yongzhou and Xue Ji the Right Regular Attendant post; both left the inner council.

sentences.zh: 特進、同中書門下三品、趙國公李嶠為懷州刺史。

translations.literal: Special Advance, Grand Counselor of the third rank, Li Jiao, Duke of Zhao, was made Huai Prefecture governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiao, Duke of Zhao, went out to govern Huai prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廢司田參軍。

translations.literal: The office of Field-plot Assessor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Field-plot Assessor post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己巳，冊平王為皇太子。

translations.literal: On jisi, Prince of Ping was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Prince of Ping was made heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，改元為景雲。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven; the era name was changed to Jingyun.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was amnestied and the reign title became Jingyun.

sentences.zh: 內外官九品已上及子為父後者各加勛一轉，自神龍以來直諫枉遭非命者咸令式墓，天下州縣名目天授以來改為「武」字者並令復舊。

translations.literal: Officials of ninth rank and above inside and outside the capital, and sons who succeeded fathers in office, each received one merit turn; from the Shenlong era those who remonstrated and died wrongfully were all granted tomb tablets; all prefectures and counties whose names had been changed to the character Wu since the Tianshou era were ordered restored to their former names.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of ninth rank and up, and sons inheriting fathers’ posts, gained one merit notch; wronged remonstrators since Shenlong received tomb tablets; counties renamed with Wu since Tianshou reverted to old names.

sentences.zh: 廢武氏崇恩廟，其昊陵、順陵並去陵名。

translations.literal: The Chongen Temple of the Wu clan was abolished; Haoling and Shunling likewise lost the word ling in their names.
translations.idiomatic: The Wu clan’s Chongen Temple was shut; Haoling and Shunling dropped the tomb suffix.

sentences.zh: 景雲元年七月己巳，制自今授左右僕射、侍中、中書令、六尚書已上官聽讓，其餘停讓。

translations.literal: On jisi of the seventh month of the first year of Jingyun, a statute provided that from now on appointees to Left and Right Vice Directors, Attendants-in-Chief, Grand Counselors, and the six ministers and above might decline if offered; the rest might not decline.
translations.idiomatic: A seventh-month statute allowed new appointees from vice director up to refuse office; lower ranks could not.

sentences.zh: 追廢皇后韋氏為庶人，安樂公主為悖逆庶人。

translations.literal: The deposed Empress Wei was posthumously reduced to commoner; Princess Anle to the rebellious commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wei was posthumously demoted to commoner; Princess Anle to “rebellious commoner.”

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改太史監為太史局，隸秘書省。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Astrological Directorate was changed to the Astrological Bureau, subordinate to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Astrological Directorate became a bureau under the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，新除集州刺史、譙王重福潛入東都構逆，州縣討平之。

translations.literal: On guisi of the eighth month, the newly appointed Qiaozhou governor, Prince of Qiao Chongfu, secretly entered the eastern capital to plot rebellion; prefectures and counties suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Prince of Qiao Chongfu, fresh Qiaozhou governor, slipped into Luoyang to rebel and was crushed by local forces.

sentences.zh: 先是，中宗時官爵渝濫，因依妃、主墨敕而授官者，謂之斜封，至是並令罷免。

translations.literal: Earlier, in Zhongzong’s time official titles had been wantonly sold; because of imperial consorts’ and princesses’ ink edicts granting office, such appointments were called “slant-seal”; now they were all ordered dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhongzong offices had been sold through consorts’ and princesses’ private edicts—“slant-seal” appointments—and now all were cashiered.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，改門下坊為左春坊，典書坊為右春坊，左右羽林衛依舊為左右羽林軍。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Gate-Down Quarters were renamed the Left Eastern Palace, the Canon-keeping Quarters the Right Eastern Palace; the Left and Right Feathered Forest Guards reverted to the Left and Right Feathered Forest Armies.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the eastern palaces were reorganized and the Feathered Forest guards again became armies.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，封皇太子男嗣貞為許昌郡王，嗣謙為真定郡王。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the ninth month, the crown prince’s son Sizhen was enfeoffed Prince of Xuchang and Siqian Prince of Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the heir’s sons Sizhen and Siqian became princes of Xuchang and Zhending.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，詔孝敬皇帝神主先祔太廟，有違古義，於東都別立義宗廟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, an edict said that installing the spirit tablet of the Filial and Respectful Emperor ahead of time in the Grand Temple violated ancient propriety; a separate Yizong Temple was to be built in the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an edict ruled that Zhongzong’s tablet in the Grand Temple broke ancient usage; Luoyang would have a separate Yizong shrine.

sentences.zh: 丁未，姚元之為中書令，兼檢校兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Yao Yuanzhi was made Grand Counselor and acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yao Yuanzhi became Grand Counselor and acting War minister.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，葬孝和皇帝於定陵。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the eleventh month, the Filial and Harmonious Emperor was buried at Dingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhongzong was buried at Dingling.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太子太師、宋王成器為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Prince of Song Chengqi, was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Chengqi, Prince of Song, became Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 蘇瑰為太子少傅，侍中、鄖國公韋安石為太子少保，改封郇國公，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: Su Gui was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Attendant-in-Chief, Duke of Yun Wei Anshi was made Junior Protector of the Heir Apparent, his fief changed to Duke of Xun, and both ceased managing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Su Gui tutored the heir; Wei Anshi, Duke of Yun, became Junior Protector as Duke of Xun—both left the inner council.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宋王成器為司徒，兼領揚州大都督。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Prince of Song Chengqi was made Minister of Works and still held the Grand Commandery of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Chengqi became Minister of Works while still commanding Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太子少傅蘇瑰薨。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Su Gui died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Su Gui died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，韋庶人、悖逆庶人並以禮改葬，武三思父子剖棺戮尸。

translations.literal: That year the commoner consort Wei and the rebellious commoner were reburied with full rites; the corpses of Wu Sansi and his son were exhumed and their bodies hacked.
translations.idiomatic: That year Empress Wei and Princess Anle were reburied properly; Wu Sansi and his son were dug up and mutilated.

sentences.zh: 景雲二年二年春正月丁未朔，以山陵日近，不受朝賀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingyun, in spring, the first month, on dingwei the new moon: because the imperial tomb day drew near, court congratulations were not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jingyun 2, on the dingwei new moon, mourning for the tomb kept the court from accepting New Year homage.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，改泉州為閩州，置都督府，改武榮州為泉州。

translations.literal: On guichou, Quanzhou was changed to Minzhou with a military governorship installed; Wurongzhou was changed to Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Quan became Min with a governor-general; Wurong reverted to Quan.

sentences.zh: 突厥默啜遣使請和親，許之。

translations.literal: The Türk Mo-ch’o sent envoys requesting a marriage alliance; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Mo-ch’o of the Turks asked for a marriage pact and was accepted.

sentences.zh: 己未，太僕卿郭元振、中書侍郎張說並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Minister of the Imperial Stud Guo Yuanzhen and Palace Draftsman Zhang Shuo were both made Grand Counselors of the third rank with the “equal” designation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Guo Yuanzhen and Zhang Shuo joined the third-rank council as “equals.”

sentences.zh: 甲子，改封溫王重茂為襄王，遷於集州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Prince of Wen Chongmao was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Xiang and moved to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Chongmao, Prince of Wen, became Prince of Xiang and was sent to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，追尊皇后劉氏為肅明皇后，墓曰惠陵；

translations.literal: On yichou, the late Empress Liu was posthumously honored as Empress Suming; her tomb was called Huiling;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Empress Liu was posthumously named Suming, tomb Huiling;

sentences.zh: 德妃竇氏為昭成皇后，墓曰靖陵。

translations.literal: Consort Dou as Empress Zhaocheng; her tomb was called Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Dou as Empress Zhaocheng, buried at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，令皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the second month, the crown prince was ordered to oversee the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the heir was told to supervise government.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，姚元之左授申州刺史，宋璟左授楚州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Yao Yuanzhi was demoted to Shenzhou governor and Song Jing to Chuzhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yao Yuanzhi and Song Jing were sent out to Shen and Chu.

sentences.zh: 韋安石為侍中。

translations.literal: Wei Anshi was made Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Anshi became Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，劉幽求為戶部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Liu Youqiu was made Minister of Revenue and ceased managing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Liu Youqiu took Revenue and left the inner council.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔中宗時斜封官並許依舊。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict allowed slant-seal officials of Zhongzong’s time to keep their posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi slant-seal appointees from Zhongzong’s reign were allowed to remain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，復置太子左右諭德、太子左右贊善，各置兩員。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Left and Right Mentors of the Heir Apparent and Left and Right Supporters of Goodness were restored, two of each.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the heir’s mentor and supporter posts were restored, two each side.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，郭元振為兵部尚書，仍依舊同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Guo Yuanzhen was made Minister of War, still Grand Counselor of the third rank with the “equal” designation as before.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Guo Yuanzhen became War minister while keeping his equal council seat.

sentences.zh: 己未，改修文館為昭文館。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Cultivated Texts Hall was changed to the Broad Texts Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Cultivated Texts Hall became the Broad Texts Hall.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎李日知為左臺御史大夫，依舊同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Attendant of the Yellow Gate Li Rizhi was made Left Censor-in-Chief, still Grand Counselor of the third rank as before.
translations.idiomatic: Li Rizhi moved to Left Censor-in-Chief while keeping third-rank council rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，張說為兵部侍郎，依舊同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengchen, Zhang Shuo was made Vice Minister of War, still Grand Counselor of the third rank with the “equal” designation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Zhang Shuo became Vice Minister of War and kept his equal council seat.

sentences.zh: 癸未，分瀛州置鄭州。

translations.literal: On guimao, Zhengzhou was established by dividing Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Ying was split to create Zheng.

sentences.zh: 詔以釋典玄宗，理均跡異，拯人化俗，教別功齊。

translations.literal: An edict said that Buddhist sutras reveal the profound origin, reason and traces differ, yet in saving men and transforming custom teaching and merit are alike.
translations.idiomatic: An edict held that Buddhist teaching and Daoist practice alike save the people—different paths, one aim.

sentences.zh: 自今每緣法事集會，僧尼、道士、女冠等宜齊行道集。

translations.literal: Henceforth at every legal assembly monks, nuns, Daoist priests, and female adepts should process together.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth at state rituals clergy of all three traditions would march together.

sentences.zh: 甲申，韋安石為中書令；

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wei Anshi was made Grand Counselor;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wei Anshi became Grand Counselor;

sentences.zh: 宋王成器為太子賓客，仍依舊遙領揚州大都督。

translations.literal: Prince of Song Chengqi was made Guest of the Heir Apparent, still holding Yangzhou Grand Commandery from afar as before.
translations.idiomatic: Chengqi, Prince of Song, became the heir’s guest while still titular Yangzhou commander.

sentences.zh: 丙申，李日知為侍中。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Li Rizhi was made Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Rizhi became Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大赦天下，重福徒黨放雪。

translations.literal: On renyin, a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven; Chongfu’s partisans were released and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the realm was amnestied and Chongfu’s followers cleared.

sentences.zh: 京官四品已下加一階，外官賜勛一轉，三品已上各賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Capital officials of fourth rank and below received one rank; outer officials one merit turn; third rank and above each received one noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officers to fourth rank rose one step; field officers one merit notch; third rank and up gained a noble grade.

sentences.zh: 天下濫度僧尼、道士、女冠並依舊。

translations.literal: Buddhist monks and nuns, Daoist priests and female adepts ordained beyond quota throughout the realm were restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: Excess ordinations of clergy nationwide were regularized.

sentences.zh: 又令內外官依上元元年九品已上文武官，咸帶手巾算袋，武官咸帶七事䩞鞢並足。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that inner and outer officials from ninth rank up, civil and military, all carry hand-towels and counting pouches as in the first year of Shangyuan; military officers all carried the seven-item saber-set and boots.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officers of ninth rank and up again wore hand-towels and pouches; soldiers carried full saber-kit and boots.

sentences.zh: 其腰帶一品至五品並用金，六品七品並用銀，八品九品並用鍮石。

translations.literal: Belts of first through fifth rank used gold; sixth and seventh silver; eighth and ninth white bronze.
translations.idiomatic: First- to fifth-rank belts were gold; sixth and seventh silver; eighth and ninth white bronze.

sentences.zh: 魚袋著紫者金裝，著緋者銀裝。

translations.literal: Fish pouches on purple robes were gold-mounted; on scarlet, silver-mounted.
translations.idiomatic: Purple robes bore gold fish-pouches; scarlet, silver.

sentences.zh: 景龍三年已前逋懸並放免。

translations.literal: Arrears before the third year of Jinglong were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax arrears before Jinglong 3 were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 天下大酺五日。

translations.literal: The realm enjoyed great feasting for five days.
translations.idiomatic: Five days of public feasting were proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，復武氏昊陵、順陵，仍量置官屬，太平公主為武攸暨請也。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Wu clan’s Haoling and Shunling were restored, with officials appointed in due measure, at Princess Taiping’s request for Wu Youji.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Wu tombs were restored with staff, at Taiping’s plea for Wu Youji.

sentences.zh: 庚申，韋安石加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wei Anshi was given the Grand Mentor of the Palace with the same ceremony as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wei Anshi received the “Opening the Mansion” honor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，改西城公主為金仙公主，昌隆公主為玉真公主，仍置金仙、玉真兩觀。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Princess of Xicheng was changed to Princess of Jinxian and Princess of Changlong to Princess of Yuzhen; the Jinxian and Yuzhen monasteries were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou two princesses were renamed and given the Jinxian and Yuzhen abbeys.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，殿中監竇懷貞為左臺御史大夫、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On renxu, Palace Director Dou Huai’zhen was made Left Censor-in-Chief and Grand Counselor of the third rank with the “equal” designation.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Dou Huai’zhen joined the council as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，依漢代故事，分置二十四都督府。

translations.literal: On renwu of the sixth month, following Han precedent, twenty-four military governorships were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month twenty-four area commands were set up on the Han model.

sentences.zh: 閏六月，初置十道按察使。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, circuit investigating commissioners were first appointed for the ten circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The intercalary month saw the first ten-circuit investigating commissioners.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，新置都督府並停。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, the newly established governorships were all halted.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the new area commands were abolished.

sentences.zh: 唯雍洛州長史、揚益荊並四大都督府長史階為三品。

translations.literal: Only the chief administrators of Yong and Luo and the four great area commands of Yang, Yi, Jing, and Bing were raised to third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Only chiefs of the two capitals and four great commands kept third-rank standing.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，詔以興聖寺是高祖舊宅，有柿樹，天授中枯死，至是重生，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On yimao of the eighth month, an edict said that Xingsheng Monastery was the High Ancestor’s old residence and had a persimmon tree that died in the Tianshou era and now lived again; a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao a dead persimmon at Gaozu’s old monastery sprouted anew; the court amnestied the realm.

sentences.zh: 其謀殺、劫殺、造偽頭首並免死配流嶺南，官典受贓者特從放免。

translations.literal: Plotters of murder, robbers of murder, and chief forgers of false documents were all spared death and sent to penal service in Lingnan; clerks who took bribes were specially released.
translations.idiomatic: Capital crimes short of the gravest were commuted to Lingnan; bribe-taking clerks were also freed.

sentences.zh: 天下大酺三日。

translations.literal: The realm enjoyed great feasting for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of public feasting followed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，皇太子釋奠於太學。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the crown prince performed the libation rite at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the heir offered at the National University.

sentences.zh: 己巳，韋安石為尚書右僕射、同中書門下三品兼太子賓客，禮部尚書竇希玠為太子少傅。

translations.literal: On jisi, Wei Anshi was made Right Vice Director and Grand Counselor of the third rank and also Guest of the Heir Apparent; Minister of Rites Dou Xijie was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wei Anshi became Right Vice Director and heir’s guest; Dou Xijie tutored the heir.

sentences.zh: 庚午，改左右屯衛為左右威衛，左右宗衛率府為左右司御府，渾儀監為太史監。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Left and Right Garrison Guards were renamed the Left and Right Martial Guards; the Left and Right Imperial Clan Guard rate offices the Left and Right Palace Horse offices; the Armillary Directorate became the Astrological Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu guard units were renamed and the armillary office became the Astrological Directorate again.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，竇懷貞為侍中。

translations.literal: On dingmao of the ninth month, Dou Huai’zhen was made Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Dou Huai’zhen became Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，吏部尚書劉幽求為侍中，散騎常侍魏知古同中書門下三品，太子詹事崔湜為中書侍郎、同中書門下三品，中書侍郎陸象先同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the tenth month of winter, Minister of Personnel Liu Youqiu was made Attendant-in-Chief; Regular Attendant Wei Zhigu Grand Counselor of the third rank; Heir Apparent Steward Cui Shi Palace Draftsman and third-rank counselor; Palace Draftsman Lu Xiangxian Grand Counselor of the third rank with the “equal” designation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Liu Youqiu became Attendant-in-Chief; Wei Zhigu joined the council; Cui Shi and Lu Xiangxian entered high office.

sentences.zh: 韋安石為尚書左僕射、東都留守，侍中李日知為戶部尚書，兵部尚書郭元振為吏部尚書，侍中兼檢校左臺御史大夫竇懷貞為左臺御史大夫，兵部侍郎兼左庶子張說為尚書左丞：罷知政事。

translations.literal: Wei Anshi was made Left Vice Director and eastern capital intendant; Attendant-in-Chief Li Rizhi Minister of Revenue; Minister of War Guo Yuanzhen Minister of Personnel; Attendant-in-Chief and acting Left Censor-in-Chief Dou Huai’zhen Left Censor-in-Chief; Vice Minister of War and Left Subprefect Zhang Shuo Left Assistant Director: all ceased managing state affairs.
